items.title: APTA Launches Campaign Tools for National Physical Therapy Month
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) launched its "PT for Future Me" campaign tools for National Physical Therapy Month, aiming to raise consumer awareness about physical therapy's role in lifelong health and wellness.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）启动了“我的未来物理治疗”宣传活动，旨在提升公众对物理治疗在全生命周期健康管理中作用的认知。这个活动是向你的患者和社区宣传物理治疗价值的好机会，利用APTA提供的资源扩大影响力。
items.titleZh: APTA 为全国物理治疗月启动宣传工具
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）为全国物理治疗月启动了“我的未来物理治疗”宣传工具，旨在提高消费者对物理治疗在全生命周期健康和福祉中作用的认知。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA has launched its "PT For Future Me" campaign to raise public awareness of physical therapy's role in lifelong health management. This campaign is a valuable opportunity for you to promote the value of physical therapy to your patients and community, leveraging the resources provided by APTA to amplify your message.

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of six studies (173 ACLR participants, 79 controls) found shear wave elastography (SWE) detects muscle-specific mechanical deficits after ACLR, with reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus (g -1.10 to -1.21) and semitendinosus stiffness (g -1.29 to -1.64) after hamstring harvest.
items.curatedReason: SWE 能捕捉 ACLR 术后股内侧肌和半腱肌在被动状态下的剪切模量和僵硬度下降（g值在-1.10至-1.64之间），这提示即使患者力量达标，其着地僵硬和再损伤风险可能仍高于预期。考虑引入 SWE 作为传统力量测试的补充，以更客观地评估肌肉力学特性。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 6 项研究（173 名 ACLR 参与者，79 名对照）的系统综述发现，剪切波弹性成像（SWE）能够检测 ACLR 术后肌肉特异性机械缺陷，表现为股内侧肌被动剪切模量（g -1.10 至 -1.21）和腘绳肌腱取后半腱肌僵硬度（g -1.29 至 -1.64）降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: SWE reveals reduced passive shear modulus and stiffness in the vastus medialis and semitendinosus after ACLR (g values between -1.10 and -1.64), suggesting that even patients meeting strength benchmarks may still have higher than expected landing stiffness and re-injury risk. Consider integrating SWE to objectively assess muscle mechanics, complementing traditional strength testing.
items.limitation: 现有研究的质量从差到好不等，且尚未有标准化协议来采样临床相关区域或长期随访至重返赛场。
items.limitationEn: Existing studies range from poor to good quality, and standardized protocols are still needed for sampling clinically relevant regions or following patients to return to sport.

items.title: Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke.
items.summary: A commentary suggests that repeated subgroup partitions in research on vagus nerve stimulation after stroke may hinder factor-specific inference.
items.curatedReason: 关于卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）的研究，该述评指出，重复的亚组划分可能会导致对因子特异性推断的混淆。在评估 VNS 这类复杂干预时，警惕过度解读或泛化特定亚组结果。
items.titleZh: 重复的亚组划分妨碍了卒中后迷走神经刺激因子特异性推断
items.summaryZh: 一项述评指出，卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）研究中重复的亚组划分，可能会妨碍对特定因子推断的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that repeated subgroup partitions in vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) research post-stroke can preclude factor-specific inference. Be cautious of over-interpreting or over-generalizing findings from specific subgroups when evaluating complex interventions like VNS.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Response to the Letter to the Editor: "Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke"

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty identified intuitive avoidance responses and external support constraints as barriers to home-based exercise, while rational adherence and negotiation strategies facilitated engagement, with implications for pain management and individualized goal setting.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术（TKA）术后的居家康复，你可能会发现患者的依从性挑战。这项对21位老年人的定性研究提示，除了疼痛，患者对运动的“直觉规避”和外部支持不足是主要障碍；而“理性坚持”和协商策略能促进他们参与。在制定居家方案时，请考虑如何识别并应对这些内在和外在因素。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后老年患者居家康复锻炼决策中的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对21名全膝关节置换术后老年患者的定性研究发现，直觉回避反应和外部支持限制是居家康复锻炼的障碍，而理性坚持和协商策略能促进参与。研究结果提示可优化疼痛管理和个体化目标设定。
items.curatedReasonEn: You'll likely encounter adherence challenges with home-based rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This qualitative study of 21 older adults suggests that beyond pain, patients' 'intuitive avoidance' of exercise and lack of external support are key barriers, while 'rational adherence' and negotiation strategies facilitate engagement. When prescribing home programs, consider how to identify and address these intrinsic and extrinsic factors.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于中国三家三级医院的患者，可能影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size, limited to patients from three tertiary hospitals in China, may affect the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Impact of Daily Physical Fatigue on Inter-Limb Load Asymmetry and Joint Loading Rates During Daily Living Tasks in Unilateral Knee Osteoarthritis
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=118) on unilateral knee OA patients found that physical fatigue significantly increased inter-limb load asymmetry during daily tasks (mean difference 8.7%), with stair negotiation showing the largest increase, potentially accelerating joint degeneration.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，身体疲劳会加剧单侧膝骨关节炎患者在日常活动中的肢体负荷不对称，尤其是爬楼梯。这提示你在评估膝 OA 患者时应考虑疲劳因素对步态生物力学的影响，并可能需要将疲劳管理和负荷重新分配作为干预重点。
items.titleZh: 单侧膝骨关节炎患者日常身体疲劳对肢体间负荷不对称和关节负荷率的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 118 名单侧膝骨关节炎患者的横断面研究发现，身体疲劳会显著加剧日常活动中的肢体间负荷不对称（平均差异 8.7%），尤其是在爬楼梯时，这可能加速关节退化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that physical fatigue exacerbates inter-limb load asymmetry in unilateral knee OA patients during daily tasks, especially stair negotiation. This suggests you should consider the impact of fatigue on gait biomechanics when assessing knee OA patients and potentially prioritize fatigue management and load redistribution in interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立疲劳与关节退化之间的因果关系，且生物力学测量是在实验室环境下进行的，可能与实际日常活动存在差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality between fatigue and joint degeneration. Biomechanical measurements were also performed in a laboratory setting, which may differ from real-world daily activities.

items.title: Smartphone Applications for Assisting Outdoor and Indoor Navigation for Persons with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: This Information/Education Page reviews key smartphone navigation applications for people with blindness or low vision (pBLV) to help clinicians identify beneficial tools for supporting patients' independent living.
items.curatedReason: 这份页面并非研究，但它提供了一个便利的综述，帮你快速了解目前市面上针对视障人士（pBLV）的主流导航App。这能协助你为患者推荐合适的工具，增强其独立生活能力。
items.titleZh: 视障人士辅助室外和室内导航的智能手机应用
items.summaryZh: 这份信息/教育页面探讨了面向视障人士的智能手机导航应用，旨在帮助临床医生更好地识别和推荐有助于患者独立生活的工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This page isn't a study, but it offers a convenient overview of major navigation apps for people with blindness or low vision (pBLV). Use it to recommend suitable tools for your patients, empowering their independent living.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Effects of a Digital Exercise Therapy Application for Patients with Shoulder and Knee Pain During the COVID-19 Pandemic
items.summary: A retrospective analysis of a digital exercise therapy application (DETA) for non-operative knee and shoulder pain found clinically meaningful improvements in pain interference (3.9 points decrease) and physical function (3.5 points increase) at 8 weeks, with greater benefits for knee pain, higher education, acute symptoms, and moderate-to-high exercise exertion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，数字运动疗法应用（DETA）对膝关节和肩关节疼痛患者的疼痛干扰和功能有临床意义的改善。对于症状较急、文化程度较高且在运动中能报告中高强度劳累的患者，DETA 可能是一个有效的辅助工具。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 疫情期间数字运动疗法应用对肩膝疼痛患者的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性分析发现，针对非手术膝关节和肩关节疼痛患者的数字运动疗法应用（DETA）在 8 周时可带来临床意义上的疼痛干扰（降低 3.9 分）和身体功能（提高 3.5 分）改善，其中膝关节疼痛患者、受教育程度较高、症状较急以及运动劳累程度中高的患者受益更大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that a digital exercise therapy application (DETA) provides clinically meaningful improvements in pain interference and function for patients with knee and shoulder pain. DETA may be an effective adjunct for patients with more acute symptoms, higher education levels, and those who report moderate-to-high exertion during exercise.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性分析，可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或其他混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective analysis, which may be subject to selection bias and lacks a control group, thus unable to rule out placebo effects or other confounding factors.

items.title: Blood pressure following resistance exercise in individuals in the chronic phase of stroke recovery
items.summary: A study (n=11 chronic stroke, n=19 controls) compared post-exercise blood pressure (BP) responses after a single bout of leg-press exercise and found no significant differences in systolic or diastolic BP changes between individuals with and without chronic stroke, suggesting similar acute BP responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本研究提示，慢性卒中患者在抗阻训练后，血压反应与健康对照组相似，支持抗阻训练的安全性。但在制定卒中患者的抗阻训练计划时，仍需考虑个体差异和更全面心血管风险评估。
items.titleZh: 卒中恢复慢性期患者抗阻运动后的血压反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（11 名慢性卒中患者，19 名对照组）比较了单次腿举抗阻运动后血压反应，发现慢性卒中患者与无卒中个体在收缩压和舒张压变化上无显著差异，提示急性血压反应相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample study suggests that blood pressure responses after resistance exercise are similar in chronic stroke patients and healthy controls, supporting the safety of resistance training. However, when developing resistance training plans for stroke patients, individual differences and a more comprehensive cardiovascular risk assessment should still be considered.
items.limitation: 研究样本量非常小（11 例卒中患者），且对照组与卒中组年龄不匹配，这些都限制了结果的普遍性和确定性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a very small sample size (11 stroke patients) and the control group was not age-matched with the stroke group, limiting the generalizability and certainty of the findings.

items.title: Hemodynamic Responses to Cold Water Ingestion During Head-Up Tilt
items.summary: In a randomized crossover study with 19 healthy young adults, drinking 200 mL of cold water during head-up tilt attenuated the fall in SBP by 5.95 mmHg (95% CI 1.99 to 9.91) in the first 4 minutes after drinking, compared to no water or body-temperature water.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对健康年轻人的 RCT 表明，在体位性应激时饮用 200 mL 冷水能在 4 分钟内将收缩压下降幅度减少约 6 mmHg。虽然样本量很小，这提示我们可以尝试建议体位性低血压患者在站立时小口饮用冷水，以期快速缓解症状，但需提醒这并非长久之计。
items.titleZh: 仰卧倾斜时冷水摄入的血流动力学反应。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 19 名健康年轻人进行的随机交叉研究显示，在仰卧倾斜时饮用 200 毫升冷水，可在饮用后最初 4 分钟内将收缩压下降幅度减少 5.95 mmHg（95% CI 1.99 至 9.91），优于不饮水或饮用常温水。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT in healthy young adults suggests that drinking 200 mL of cold water during orthostatic stress can reduce the fall in SBP by about 6 mmHg within 4 minutes. While the sample size is small, it hints that we might cautiously suggest patients with orthostatic hypotension sip cold water when standing for quick symptom relief, but emphasize this is not a long-term solution.
items.limitation: 这是一项在健康年轻人中进行的初步研究，结果是预印本，且未评估对病理状态下体位性低血压患者的临床意义。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary preprint study conducted in healthy young adults, and its clinical significance for patients with pathological orthostatic hypotension has not been assessed.

items.title: Stakeholder-informed prioritisation of HealthTech innovation across chronic respiratory disease: the HERON study
items.summary: The HERON study identified 73 candidate HealthTech solution areas across 16 priority domains for chronic respiratory disease (CRD) through stakeholder engagement (N=314 patients, carers, HCPs), with 52/73 (71.2%) having existing technological capability.
items.curatedReason: 这项利益相关者共识研究指出了慢性呼吸系统疾病 HealthTech 解决方案的 16 个优先领域，其中 71.2% 已有技术基础。作为临床医生，这提醒我们关注这些新兴技术，思考如何将其整合到日常实践中，以更好地支持患者的自我管理和疾病治疗，而不是等待现有方案迭代。
items.titleZh: 慢性呼吸系统疾病 HealthTech 创新的利益相关者优先排序：HERON 研究。
items.summaryZh: HERON 研究通过利益相关者（314 名患者、护理人员、医疗专业人员）参与，确定了慢性呼吸系统疾病 (CRD) 的 73 个 HealthTech 候选解决方案领域，涵盖 16 个优先领域，其中 52/73 (71.2%) 已具备现有技术能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This stakeholder consensus study highlights 16 priority domains for HealthTech solutions in chronic respiratory disease, with 71.2% having existing technological capability. As clinicians, this prompts us to pay attention to these emerging technologies and consider how to integrate them into daily practice to better support patient self-management and disease treatment, rather than waiting for current solutions to iterate.
items.limitation: 本研究主要依赖利益相关者的主观意见，优先级的确定可能受限于参与者的背景和当前认知。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily relies on subjective stakeholder opinions, and prioritization may be limited by participants' backgrounds and current understanding.

items.title: Mirror therapy versus functional electrical stimulation cycling in post-stroke lower limb rehabilitation: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that both mirror therapy (MD -2.60, 95% CI -5.83 to -0.63, p=0.004) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (MD -3.00, 95% CI -6.23 to -0.23, p=0.008) improved lower extremity motor function more than conventional rehabilitation in subacute stroke patients, with no significant difference between the two adjunct therapies.
items.curatedReason: 镜面疗法与功能性电刺激辅助循环训练在亚急性卒中下肢康复中均显示出优于常规治疗的效果，且两者之间无显著差异。这表明成本较低、更易获取的镜面疗法是可行的选择，在资源有限的诊所里，可以放心地将其作为下肢功能恢复的辅助干预手段。
items.titleZh: 卒中后下肢康复中的镜面疗法与功能性电刺激辅助循环训练：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）显示，亚急性卒中患者下肢康复中，镜面疗法（MD -2.60, 95% CI -5.83 to -0.63, p=0.004）和功能性电刺激辅助循环训练（MD -3.00, 95% CI -6.23 to -0.23, p=0.008）均比常规康复能带来更大的下肢运动功能改善，且两种辅助疗法之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mirror therapy (MT) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (FES-C) both demonstrated superior outcomes to conventional therapy for subacute stroke lower limb rehabilitation, with no significant differences between them. This suggests that the more accessible and less costly MT is a viable option for lower limb functional recovery in resource-limited clinics, and you can confidently use it as an adjunct intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（每组 15 人），随访期仅 6 周，可能限制了长期效果和更广泛人群的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (15 per group) and a short 6-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and broader populations.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: A process evaluation of the Enhanced Rehabilitation after Major Trauma Programme (ERP) in the UK, following the Manchester Arena bombing, found it was valued by patients and physiotherapists for its structured, multidisciplinary approach, but sustainability and integration into routine NHS care remain challenging.
items.curatedReason: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后的强化康复项目（ERP）效果积极，但大规模推广面临资源和系统障碍。这提示你在设计高强度康复项目时，需要同步考虑其在现实 NHS 系统中的可持续性和过渡衔接问题。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后严重肌肉骨骼损伤强化康复项目的过程评估：调查患者和物理治疗师的经验
items.summaryZh: 英国曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后实施的创伤强化康复项目（ERP）在患者和物理治疗师中获得积极评价，认可其结构化、多学科康复方法。但研究指出，该项目在 NHS 系统中的可持续性和与常规护理的衔接仍面临挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) following the Manchester Arena bombing showed positive outcomes, but widespread adoption faces resource and systemic barriers. This suggests that when designing intensive rehabilitation programs, consider their sustainability and transition within real-world healthcare systems like the NHS.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性方法，主要反映患者和物理治疗师的经验，而非量化项目疗效或成本效益。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study primarily reflects patient and physiotherapist experiences, not quantified treatment efficacy or cost-effectiveness.

items.title: Rehabilitation after stroke for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and Indigenous peoples globally: a scoping review and critical content analysis.
items.summary: A scoping review of 108 sources on stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples globally reveals that care is heavily influenced by colonization, racism, and Western health perspectives, emphasizing the need for self-determined, culturally aligned rehabilitation models.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述揭示了全球原住民卒中康复中存在的系统性殖民影响和西方健康观主导的问题。这提示你在为原住民患者提供服务时，必须深入理解并整合其文化价值观和世界观，促进以患者为中心的自决康复模式。
items.titleZh: 全球原住民卒中康复：一项范围审查和批判性内容分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对全球原住民卒中康复的范围审查（纳入 108 篇文献）发现，康复服务深受殖民化、种族主义和西方健康观主导的影响。研究强调，未来的临床护理需要转变，以实现原住民自决的康复模式，并与他们的文化健康模式对齐。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights systemic colonial impacts and the dominance of Western health perspectives in stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples globally. This suggests that when treating Indigenous patients, you must deeply understand and integrate their cultural values and worldviews to promote patient-centered, self-determined rehabilitation models.
items.limitation: 本综述的广度可能限制了对特定原住民群体康复实践的深入分析。
items.limitationEn: The broad scope of this review may limit in-depth analysis of specific Indigenous rehabilitation practices.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summary: A survey of German surgeons (n=183) showed variability in recommendations for return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with most suggesting regular activity from around 8 weeks. A separate patient survey (n=106) reported actual return to sports at 12.1 ± 11.7 weeks, highlighting a discrepancy between recommendations and patient behavior.
items.curatedReason: 这项德国研究显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的时间存在显著差异，外科医生建议的时间与患者实际重返时间不一致。这提示你在制定患者重返运动计划时，不应只依赖单一医生的建议，而应更精细地评估患者个体情况和功能进展，同时认识到现有指南的证据局限性。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动：一项德国外科医生调查与患者术后经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对德国外科医生（n=183）的调查显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的建议存在差异，多数建议在术后约 8 周恢复常规运动。另一项针对患者（n=106）的调查则报告实际重返运动时间为 12.1 ± 11.7 周，凸显了建议与患者行为之间的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This German study reveals significant variability in return-to-sport timing after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with surgeon recommendations not aligning with actual patient return. This suggests that when creating return-to-sport plans, you should not rely solely on a single physician's advice but rather conduct a more nuanced assessment of individual patient conditions and functional progress, while acknowledging the limited evidence in current guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究结合了外科医生在线问卷和单中心患者调查，两者设计和背景存在差异，数据不直接可比，且患者样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This study combined an online surgeon survey and a single-center patient survey, which have differing designs and contexts, making their data not directly comparable, and the patient sample size is relatively small.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) has published a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach for rehabilitating athletes with hamstring strain injury, providing evidence-based guidance for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: SONAFE-Brazil 发布的最新腘绳肌拉伤康复临床实践指南是本领域的里程碑，使用 GRADE 证据分级。它将直接指导你对运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复干预策略，务必深入研读其推荐意见。
items.titleZh: 运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南
items.summaryZh: 巴西国家运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了一项临床实践指南，采用 GRADE 方法，旨在为物理治疗师提供运动员腘绳肌拉伤康复的循证指导。
items.curatedReasonEn: The latest clinical practice guideline for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation from SONAFE-Brazil, using GRADE, is a landmark in this field. It will directly inform your rehabilitation strategies for athletes with hamstring strain injuries, so be sure to study its recommendations thoroughly.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence on whether reduced spinal range of motion is a prognostic factor for pain intensity, disability, and global recovery in people with specific or nonspecific spinal pain, with most studies reporting no clear association and high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述（37 项研究）明确指出，脊柱活动度降低是否能预测脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛强度、残疾或整体恢复，证据确定性极低。别再把活动度限制当做核心预后指标，这可能分散你对其他更重要因素的注意力。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度降低是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的预后因素吗？一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 37 项研究的系统综述发现，关于脊柱活动度降低是否能预测特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的证据确定性极低，多数研究未显示明确关联，且偏倚风险高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review (37 studies) clearly states that the evidence for reduced spinal ROM predicting pain intensity, disability, or global recovery in spinal pain patients is of very low certainty. Stop treating ROM restriction as a core prognostic indicator, as this may distract you from more critical factors.
items.limitation: 纳入研究普遍存在高偏倚风险，且结果异质性高，导致证据确定性极低。
items.limitationEn: Included studies generally had a high risk of bias and high heterogeneity in results, leading to very low certainty of evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=14) exploring patients' experiences with physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction found it a valuable complement to physical visits, improving accessibility and continuity, while highlighting the need for advanced communication and reliable technology.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复能提高产后盆底功能障碍患者的可及性和依从性。研究提示，混合模式（远程与当面结合）最能满足患者需求，但在数字化沟通能力和技术支持上，你仍需下功夫。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=14）探讨了产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验，发现远程康复是实体就诊的有效补充，提高了可及性和依从性，但也强调了先进沟通技巧和可靠技术的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation improves accessibility and adherence for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction. Findings suggest a hybrid care model (remote + in-person) best meets patient needs, but you must focus on digital communication skills and robust tech support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Single Ultrasound-Guided Dextrose Prolotherapy Plus Therapeutic Exercise for Subacromial-Subdeltoid Bursitis: A Pilot Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot double-blind randomized controlled trial investigates the efficacy of single ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy plus therapeutic exercise for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis, a common cause of shoulder pain and disability.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 初步显示，单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动可有效改善肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎。如果你的患者对常规治疗反应不佳，这可能是一个值得探索的新选择，但尚需大型研究来确证。
items.titleZh: 单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动治疗肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎：一项初步双盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步双盲随机对照试验旨在探讨单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动对肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎（一种常见的肩痛和致残原因）的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that single ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy combined with therapeutic exercise may be effective for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis. If your patients are not responding to conventional treatments, this could be a new option to explore, but larger studies are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小型预试验，样本量有限，结果的普适性需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot study with a limited sample size, and the generalizability of its findings requires further validation with larger studies.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial argues that telerehabilitation is a necessary evolution in musculoskeletal physical therapy, extending the therapist's role through continuous monitoring and patient engagement, rather than merely replacing traditional care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调远程康复应是肌骨物理治疗的“必要演进”，而非简单替代。要拥抱新模式，你必须培养新的数字技能，整合工具，同时维护医患关系。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必要演进
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，远程康复是肌骨物理治疗的必要演进，它通过持续监测和患者参与来扩展治疗师的角色，而非仅仅替代传统治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights telerehabilitation as a "necessary evolution" for musculoskeletal physical therapy, not just a replacement. To embrace new models, you must develop new digital skills, integrate tools, and maintain therapeutic relationships.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (13 RCTs, 1 observational) found very uncertain evidence for dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic mixed rotator cuff tendinopathy and/or subacromial bursitis, showing little to no benefit compared to normal saline (SMD medium-term: -0.3 [-1.0; 0.4]; very low COE) and possibly worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖肌腱病变的葡萄糖增生疗法仍然证据不足。本综述发现与生理盐水相比，其短期到中期益处甚微；与皮质类固醇注射相比，甚至可能导致身体表现更差。别急着常规推广。
items.titleZh: 葡萄糖增生疗法治疗慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病变和肩峰下滑囊炎：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 14 项研究（13 项随机对照试验、1 项观察性研究）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，葡萄糖增生疗法治疗慢性症状性混合型肩袖肌腱病变和/或肩峰下滑囊炎的证据非常不确定，与生理盐水相比，短期至中期益处甚微（中期标准化均差 [SMD]：-0.3 [-1.0; 0.4]；证据确定性非常低），与皮质类固醇注射相比，甚至可能导致身体表现更差。
items.curatedReasonEn: Dextrose prolotherapy for rotator cuff tendinopathy remains inconclusive. This review found little to no short-to-medium-term benefit compared to saline, and possibly worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections. Exercise caution before routine adoption.
items.limitation: 大多数纳入研究（14 项中有 10 项）存在高偏倚风险，且多为小样本短期研究，证据确定性非常低到中等。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies (10 out of 14) had a high risk of bias, and were mostly small, short-term studies, leading to very low to moderate certainty of evidence.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Methodological quality of systematic reviews on treatments in stroke rehabilitation: A cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study evaluating 140 systematic reviews (SRs) on stroke rehabilitation treatments found that 92.9% were of critically low methodological quality, with only 1.4% rated as high. Key methodological flaws included insufficient literature search (4.3% comprehensive) and inadequate reporting of excluded studies (12.9% with justifications).
items.curatedReason: 脑卒中康复领域系统综述的质量令人担忧，高达 92.9% 被评为“极低质量”。你在引用任何综述之前，务必自行评估其方法学，因为多数可能不可靠。
items.titleZh: 脑卒中康复治疗系统综述方法学质量：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项评估 140 篇脑卒中康复治疗系统综述的横断面研究发现，92.9% 的综述方法学质量极低，仅有 1.4% 被评为高质量。主要方法学缺陷包括文献检索不全面（仅 4.3% 做到全面检索）和排除研究报告不充分（仅 12.9% 提供排除理由）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The quality of systematic reviews in stroke rehabilitation is concerning, with 92.9% rated as 'critically low quality'. Always evaluate the methodology of any review before citing it, as most may be unreliable.
items.limitation: 本研究的评估对象仅限于 2021 年 1 月至 2023 年 9 月发表的系统综述，可能无法完全代表所有历史和未来综述的质量。
items.limitationEn: This study's assessment was limited to systematic reviews published between January 2021 and September 2023, which may not fully represent the quality of all historical and future reviews.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Target Precision Shapes Trunk Compensation After Stroke: Neuromechanical Consequences for Upper Limb Rehabilitation
items.summary: In individuals with stroke, trunk compensation was 15% lower for large targets than small targets, independently of arm weight. Movement time was 24% longer for small targets. This suggests trunk compensation is modulated by task demands, indicating that rehabilitation should evaluate compensation by its functional role and treat target size as an adjustable parameter.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后躯干代偿并非固定不变的损伤表现，而是会受任务需求调节，尤其是目标精确度。在康复训练中，您可以将目标大小作为一个可调节的参数，更精准地评估代偿的功能角色及其抑制成本，而非仅仅关注其与典型运动学偏差。
items.titleZh: 目标精确度影响卒中后躯干代偿：对上肢康复的神经机械学影响。
items.summaryZh: 卒中患者在进行触及任务时，大目标比小目标躯干代偿低 15%，且与手臂重量无关。小目标导致运动时间延长 24%。这表明躯干代偿受任务需求调节，康复中应根据其功能角色评估代偿，并将目标大小作为可调节参数。
items.curatedReasonEn: Trunk compensation after stroke is not a fixed impairment but is modulated by task demands, particularly target precision. In rehabilitation, you can use target size as an adjustable parameter to more precisely evaluate the functional role of compensation and the cost of suppressing it, rather than just its deviation from typical kinematics.
items.limitation: 这是一项非同行评审预印本，样本量相对较小（22 名卒中患者和 22 名对照），且研究未直接证明最优控制理论，仅指出其结果与该理论一致。
items.limitationEn: This is a non-peer-reviewed preprint with a relatively small sample size (22 stroke participants and 22 controls), and the study did not directly prove optimal control theory, only noted its consistency with the theory.

items.title: Beyond Walking Speed: Estimating and Classifying Post-Stroke Gait Propulsion From Standardized Clinical Measures
items.summary: Standardized clinical measures (6MWT, SPPB, TUG, FMA-LE, chronicity) can estimate post-stroke gait propulsion metrics (paretic propulsion peak, impulse, interlimb symmetry) with R² up to 0.81 and classify propulsion impairment with 84.8% accuracy. This offers a practical assessment in settings without specialized instrumentation.
items.curatedReason: 通过结合 6MWT、SPPB、TUG 等标准化临床测量，您可以在没有复杂设备的情况下，高精度地估计和分类卒中后步态推进障碍。这有助于在临床实践中更便捷地进行康复评估和干预决策。
items.titleZh: 超越步行速度：从标准化临床测量评估和分类卒中后步态推进。
items.summaryZh: 标准化临床测量（6MWT、SPPB、TUG、FMA-LE、卒中病程）可有效估计卒中后步态推进指标（患侧推进峰值、冲量、肢体间对称性），R² 值高达 0.81，并以 84.8% 的准确率分类推进障碍。这为缺乏专业仪器的临床环境提供了实用评估方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: By combining standardized clinical measures such as 6MWT, SPPB, and TUG, you can accurately estimate and classify post-stroke gait propulsion impairment without complex equipment. This facilitates more convenient rehabilitation assessment and intervention decisions in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项非同行评审预印本，研究是在单一中心进行，样本量较小（40 名卒中患者），且模型需在更广泛的临床人群中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a non-peer-reviewed preprint, conducted at a single center with a small sample size (40 stroke participants), and the models require further validation in a broader clinical population.

items.title: CMS Convenes Certified Independent Dispute Resolution Entity Leaders to Discuss Ways to Improve the Federal Program
items.summary: CMS is convening leaders of Certified Independent Dispute Resolution Entities to discuss ways to improve the federal program.
items.curatedReason: 独立争议解决实体领导齐聚 CMS，意味着联邦医保争议解决流程有望优化。如果你常处理相关事务，需密切关注此次讨论结果，它可能直接影响你未来的争议解决效率和策略。
items.titleZh: 了解更多关于 CMS 召集认证独立争议解决实体领导人讨论改进联邦项目的方法。
items.summaryZh: CMS 正在召集认证独立争议解决实体（Certified Independent Dispute Resolution Entity）的领导人，讨论改进联邦项目的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: With Certified Independent Dispute Resolution Entities leaders meeting at CMS, expect potential shifts in the federal Medicare dispute resolution program. If you frequently navigate these processes, this meeting's outcomes will likely impact your future efficiency and strategic approach.

items.title: Applications of MyotonPRO in the upper limb: a scoping review of orthopaedic, traumatologic, rehabilitation, and sports medicine evidence
items.summary: A scoping review of 243 studies found MyotonPRO promising for assessing upper limb soft tissue biomechanical properties and monitoring exercise effects, but highlighted significant methodological heterogeneity and small sample sizes, particularly in orthopedic and traumatology fields.
items.curatedReason: MyotonPRO 作为评估上肢软组织生物力学特性的工具前景广阔，但其在骨科和创伤学领域的具体诊断和治疗应用仍需更严谨、大样本的研究来明确。
items.titleZh: MyotonPRO 在上肢应用：骨科、创伤、康复和运动医学证据的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 243 项研究进行的范围综述发现，MyotonPRO 在评估上肢软组织生物力学特性和监测运动效果方面表现出潜力，但现有研究存在显著的方法学异质性和小样本量，尤其在骨科和创伤学领域的应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: MyotonPRO shows promise for assessing upper limb soft tissue biomechanics, but its specific diagnostic and therapeutic applications in orthopedics and traumatology require more rigorous, larger-sample studies for clarity.
items.limitation: 现有研究方法学异质性高且样本量偏小，尤其在骨科和创伤学领域的应用研究数量有限。
items.limitationEn: Existing studies show high methodological heterogeneity and small sample sizes, with limited research specifically on orthopedic and traumatological applications.

items.title: From Visits to Value
items.summary: New payment models and a physical therapist-led frailty pilot program demonstrate how functional gains can improve outcomes and reduce costs within the evolving value-based care landscape for physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 价值医疗模式已不再是遥远的未来，而是正在渗透 PT 实践，尤其是通过老年衰弱试点项目，它强调功能改善在降低成本和优化患者结局中的核心作用。
items.titleZh: 从访视到价值：PT 主导的衰弱试点项目展示功能改善如何降低成本和优化结局
items.summaryZh: 新的支付模式和一项由物理治疗师主导的衰弱试点项目表明，在不断发展的价值医疗环境中，功能性改善如何提高患者结局并降低成本。
items.curatedReasonEn: Value-based care is no longer a distant future but is actively integrating into PT practice, particularly through geriatric frailty pilot programs, emphasizing functional gains in reducing costs and optimizing patient outcomes.

items.title: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summary: A study in 33 neurotypical adults found that self-evaluation of temporal gait asymmetry was more accurate than spatial asymmetry (OR = 0.09 [0.02, 0.51] for presence) and directing attention to the swing phase improved temporal asymmetry self-evaluation (OR = 0.13 [0.04, 0.40]).
items.curatedReason: 这项针对神经典型成年人的初步研究提示，在卒中后步态不对称的康复中，患者对时间不对称的自我评估可能比空间不对称更准确，并且将注意力集中在摆动相可能提高评估准确性。
items.titleZh: 神经典型青年人诱导时间与空间步态不对称自我评估的探索
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 33 名神经典型成年人的研究发现，对时间性步态不对称的自我评估比空间性不对称更准确（存在性 OR = 0.09 [0.02, 0.51]），且将注意力集中于摆动相能提高时间性不对称的自我评估准确性（OR = 0.13 [0.04, 0.40]）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study in neurotypical adults suggests that in post-stroke gait asymmetry rehabilitation, patients' self-evaluation of temporal asymmetry may be more accurate than spatial asymmetry, and focusing attention on the swing phase could improve assessment accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量较小（33 名），且仅针对神经典型成年人，其结果外推至卒中患者需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (33 participants) and was conducted only on neurotypical adults, so its findings should be generalized to stroke patients with caution.

items.title: Transitions and predictive factors of cognitive frailty states in rural older adults: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study of 3,243 rural older adults from China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study found cognitive frailty (CF) to be reversible, with the intensity of recovery from reversible CF (RCF) to only non-dementia cognitive impairment (NDCI) being 0.429 (95% CI 0.359–0.512), highlighting early RCF as a key intervention window.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型队列研究首次明确了农村老年人认知衰弱的可逆性，并识别出早期RCF状态为关键干预窗口。这为你针对农村老年患者的早期筛查和可调节因素管理提供了坚实的证据基础，尤其是针对RCF状态的干预，能有效逆转认知衰弱并预防不良结局。
items.titleZh: 农村老年人认知衰弱状态的转变及预测因素：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对3,243名中国农村老年人的前瞻性队列研究发现，认知衰弱（CF）是可逆的，可逆性CF（RCF）恢复到非痴呆认知障碍（NDCI）的强度为0.429（95% CI 0.359–0.512），强调早期RCF是关键干预窗口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study is the first to clearly establish the reversible nature of cognitive frailty in rural older adults and identifies the early RCF state as a critical intervention window. This provides a strong evidence base for your early screening and management of modifiable factors in rural older patients, particularly for RCF interventions, to effectively reverse cognitive frailty and prevent adverse outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究人群为中国农村老年人，结果可能不完全适用于其他地域和文化背景。
items.limitationEn: The study population consists of rural older adults in China, and the results may not be fully generalizable to other geographical and cultural contexts.

items.title: OTC analgesic use was associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play (aHR 1.
items.summary: OTC analgesic use was associated with a higher rate of return to unrestricted play (aHR 1.25, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.39) and lower 3-day postinjury SCAT3 symptom severity (aHR=0.70, 95% CI 0.62 to 0.79) in NCAA and non-NCAA athletes post-concussion.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，非处方止痛药（尤其是对乙酰氨基酚）与脑震荡症状的改善和更快的恢复相关。下次面对脑震荡患者时，可以将此纳入你的症状管理考量，但要留意观察性研究的局限性。
items.titleZh: 非处方止痛药改善脑震荡后症状和恢复：脑震荡评估、研究与教育（CARE）联盟的发现
items.summaryZh: 研究显示，非处方止痛药（OTC）使用与运动员脑震荡后恢复至无限制训练（aHR 1.25）和3天后SCAT3症状减轻（aHR=0.70）呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that OTC analgesics (especially acetaminophen) are associated with improved concussion symptoms and faster recovery. Consider this for symptom management in concussion patients, but be mindful of the limitations of observational research.
items.limitation: 研究为观察性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational cohort study, which may have confounding factors and cannot establish causality.

items.title: APTA Magazine: October/November 2026
items.summary: The October/November 2026 issue of APTA Magazine features articles on new payment models, a PT-led frailty pilot program, and updated guidance for total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation, focusing on functional gains and digital care.
items.curatedReason: 本期 APTA 杂志探讨了新的支付模式、PT 主导的衰弱试点项目以及全膝关节置换术康复指南的更新。这些内容将直接影响你的执业策略和临床实践，特别是在价值导向护理和 TKA 康复管理方面。
items.titleZh: APTA 杂志：2026 年 10 月/11 月
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月/11月《APTA杂志》刊登了关于新型支付模式、PT主导的衰弱试点项目以及全膝关节置换术康复指南更新的文章，强调功能改善和数字化护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This issue of APTA Magazine discusses new payment models, a PT-led frailty pilot, and updated guidelines for total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation. This content will directly impact your practice strategies and clinical practice, particularly in value-based care and TKA rehab management.

items.title: How to ensure the implementability of multi-component interventions to improve active ageing in older people? An overview of the evidence of systematic reviews
items.summary: An overview of eight systematic reviews identified a gap between the use of implementation frameworks and consistent reporting of implementation outcomes in multi-component interventions for active aging, with acceptability consistently reported but appropriateness and feasibility least frequently evaluated.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述的综述强调了在促进老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预中，实施框架应用与报告实施结果之间存在差距。这提示你在评估相关干预措施时，要更批判性地审视其实施的可行性、适宜性和可持续性数据。
items.titleZh: 如何确保改善老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预措施的可实施性？系统综述证据概述
items.summaryZh: 八项系统综述的概述发现，在促进老年人积极老龄化的多组分干预中，实施框架的应用与实施结果的报告存在差距；可接受性常被报告，但适宜性和可行性评估最少。
items.curatedReasonEn: This overview of reviews highlights a gap between the use of implementation frameworks and the reporting of implementation outcomes in multi-component interventions for active aging. This suggests a need to critically examine the feasibility, appropriateness, and sustainability data when evaluating such interventions.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述数量较少，且实施框架应用和结果报告存在异质性，可能限制结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included systematic reviews and the heterogeneity in implementation framework application and outcome reporting may limit the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: President's Note | Choosing What Matters
items.summary: The APTA President's note discusses the profession's responsibility to prioritize and adapt to emerging research, technologies, and payment models to make a meaningful difference for patients and communities.
items.curatedReason: 作为物理治疗师，我们需要主动适应新的研究、技术和支付模式，从而在患者和社区中发挥更大的作用。APTA 主席的这篇社论提醒我们，专业发展必须兼顾创新与实际效用，才能避免被时代淘汰。
items.titleZh: 主席寄语 | 选择重要的事
items.summaryZh: APTA 主席的寄语强调，在面对新研究、新技术和新支付模式时，物理治疗专业需要审慎选择重点，以对患者和社区产生有意义的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: As physical therapists, we must proactively adapt to new research, technologies, and payment models to make a greater difference for patients and communities. The APTA President's note reminds us that professional development must balance innovation with practical utility to avoid being left behind.

items.title: Development and validation of a Chinese self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury.
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated a 45-item, 5-dimension self-management ability assessment scale for patients with spinal cord injury (SCI) in China. The scale demonstrated good reliability (Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974, test-retest 0.718-0.94) and validity.
items.curatedReason: 有了这份针对中国 SCI 患者的 45 项多维度自我管理量表，你现在可以更系统地评估患者能力，并精准识别康复支持和教育需求。其高信效度数据（Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974, 重测信度 0.718-0.94）提示它是个可靠的工具。
items.titleZh: 中国脊髓损伤患者自我管理能力评估量表的开发与验证
items.summaryZh: 研究人员开发并验证了一个包含 45 个条目、5 个维度的中国脊髓损伤（SCI）患者自我管理能力评估量表。该量表显示出良好的信度（Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974，重测信度 0.718-0.94）和效度。
items.curatedReasonEn: With this 45-item, multidimensional self-management scale for Chinese SCI patients, you can now systematically assess patient abilities and precisely identify rehabilitation support and educational needs. Its high reliability and validity (Cronbach's α 0.845-0.974, test-retest 0.718-0.94) suggest it's a trustworthy tool.
items.limitation: 该量表在单一文化背景下开发和验证，其跨文化适用性尚需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The scale was developed and validated in a single cultural context, and its cross-cultural applicability requires further research.

items.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: This randomized clinical trial investigates the effects of blood flow restriction training (BFRT) on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中患者的下肢运动功能和平衡障碍，BFRT 是一个值得考虑的辅助治疗手段。这项 RCT 提供了支持证据，提示你可以在临床实践中谨慎引入，但务必结合患者个体情况，并留意其长期效应的进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 血流限制训练对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机临床试验研究了血流限制训练（BFRT）对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: BFRT is a viable adjunctive treatment to consider for lower limb motor dysfunction and balance issues in stroke patients. This RCT provides supportive evidence, suggesting you can cautiously introduce it into clinical practice, but always consider individual patient circumstances and await further research on its long-term effects.
items.limitation: 研究未披露具体样本量和关键效应量，评估其临床意义存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not disclose specific sample size or key effect sizes, limiting the assessment of its clinical significance.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: An action-research study developed and piloted “Let's Move,” an early exercise program for hospitalized adults. Among 26 participants, 76.5% were adherent, no adverse events occurred, and 96.2% achieved individualized goals, supporting its feasibility and safety.
items.curatedReason: 在住院成人中，早期运动计划“Let's Move”显示出良好可行性和安全性：26 名参与者中，76.5%依从性高，无不良事件，96.2%达成目标。这提示你，类似项目在设计和试点时可以参考其经验，但推广前仍需更多高级别证据。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动项目“Let's Move”的设计
items.summaryZh: 一项行动研究开发并试点了一个针对住院成年人的早期运动项目“Let's Move”。在 26 名参与者中，76.5% 的人依从性良好，未发生不良事件，96.2% 的人达到了个体化目标，支持了其可行性和安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The “Let's Move” early exercise program for hospitalized adults demonstrated good feasibility and safety: among 26 participants, 76.5% were adherent, no adverse events occurred, and 96.2% achieved individualized goals. This suggests you can draw from its design and pilot experience for similar programs, but higher-level evidence is needed before widespread implementation.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心试点项目，样本量较小，且排除了有物理治疗转诊的患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center pilot study with a small sample size, and it excluded patients with physiotherapy referrals, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Adolescent Mental Health Risk post-mild Traumatic Brain Injury: Examination of Diagnostic codes in Electronic Health Records
items.summary: This study examines the frequency and association of post-mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) mental health diagnoses in adolescents, aiming to understand prevalence and risk factors.
items.curatedReason: 青少年 mTBI 患者不只是躯体症状，更要警惕潜在的心理健康共病。这项研究提示，你在评估这类患者时，应将早期筛查和管理心理健康问题纳入常规流程，因为其发生频率和关联性不容忽视。
items.titleZh: 轻度创伤性脑损伤后青少年心理健康风险：电子健康记录中诊断编码的检验
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在通过检查电子健康记录中的诊断编码，了解轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）后心理健康诊断的频率和关联，以探讨其患病率和风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adolescent mTBI patients, physical symptoms are not the only concern; potential mental health comorbidities are critical. This study suggests you should integrate early screening and management of mental health issues into your routine assessment for these patients, as their frequency and association are significant.
items.limitation: 该研究基于电子健康记录的诊断编码，可能存在编码偏差和信息不完整性，影响风险因素的准确性。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on diagnostic codes from electronic health records, which may introduce coding bias and incompleteness, affecting the accuracy of risk factor identification.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Interpreting Per-Protocol Efficacy Signals in a Pilot Trial of Inspiratory Muscle Training
items.summary: This commentary discusses the interpretation of per-protocol efficacy signals in a pilot trial of inspiratory muscle training (IMT) for patients with knee osteoarthritis awaiting total knee arthroplasty. It highlights that the statistically significant improvement in estimated maximal oxygen consumption (V̇O₂max) was derived from an analysis restricted to adherent participants, warranting clarification in interpreting the efficacy signal.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒你，在解读一项关于吸气肌训练（IMT）用于全膝关节置换术前康复的初步试验结果时，应注意其"遵从方案"分析的局限性。虽然 IMT 显示出预期的效果，但由于该试验仅限于依从性高的参与者，你应谨慎将此结果推广到所有患者，尤其是在进行常规临床决策时。
items.titleZh: 解读一项吸气肌训练初步试验中的"遵从方案"疗效信号
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评讨论了如何解读一项关于吸气肌训练（IMT）用于膝骨关节炎患者全膝关节置换术前康复的初步试验中，"遵从方案"疗效信号。它强调估计的最大摄氧量（V̇O₂max）的统计学显著改善是基于对依从性高的参与者的分析，因此在解释疗效信号时需谨慎。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds you to be cautious when interpreting results from a pilot trial on inspiratory muscle training (IMT) for preoperative total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation, especially regarding its per-protocol analysis. While IMT showed promising effects, the findings were restricted to adherent participants, so you should be careful in generalizing these results to all patients, particularly when making routine clinical decisions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Toward personalized exergaming: a machine learning-based decision-support approach to cognitive-motor training for long-term care residents with cognitive impairments
items.summary: A cross-sectional study with 100 long-term care residents developed a machine learning model to predict personalized exergaming recommendations, achieving a ROC-AUC of 0.79 in cross-validation.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究展示了机器学习在为认知障碍长期照护居民提供个性化认知运动训练（exergaming）推荐方面的潜力。虽然还在早期，但这一方法预示着未来你可能能更精准地为患者选择数字干预方案。
items.titleZh: 迈向个性化体感游戏：基于机器学习的决策支持方法，用于认知障碍长期照护居民的认知运动训练
items.summaryZh: 一项对 100 名长期照护居民进行的横断面研究开发了一个机器学习模型，旨在预测个性化体感游戏推荐，并在交叉验证中实现了 0.79 的 ROC-AUC。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates the potential of machine learning to personalize cognitive-motor training (exergaming) for long-term care residents with cognitive impairments. Although early, this approach suggests a future where you might more precisely select digital interventions for patients.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法推断干预效果或因果关系，且模型在预测辅助需求方面的性能较低（AUC = 0.67–0.71）。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference regarding intervention effects, and the model showed lower performance in predicting assistance needs (AUC = 0.67–0.71).

items.title: Enhancing mountain safety through personalised exercise prescription: the MOVE project (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: The MOVE project developed a personalized digital decision-support system to enhance mountain hiking safety by integrating individual health characteristics with trail-specific demands.
items.curatedReason: 这个博士项目开发的 MOVE 系统旨在通过个性化运动处方提高登山安全性，考虑到个体健康特征与路径需求。如果你关注运动康复和安全重返运动，这提示了未来数字工具在户外运动风险评估和预防中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 通过个性化运动处方提高登山安全性：MOVE 项目（博士学会奖）
items.summaryZh: MOVE 项目开发了一套个性化数字决策支持系统，通过整合个体健康特征和路径具体要求，以提升登山安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD project developed the MOVE system to enhance mountain hiking safety through personalized exercise prescriptions, considering individual health characteristics and trail demands. If you focus on sports rehabilitation and safe return to sport, this highlights the future potential of digital tools in outdoor activity risk assessment and prevention.

items.title:
Sense of coherence and rehabilitation outcomes: a 3-year longitudinal study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 3-year longitudinal cohort study (n=601) found that both baseline Sense of Coherence and changes in it were independently associated with rehabilitation outcomes, with stronger associations for overall health and mental functioning.
items.curatedReason: 这项为期三年的前瞻性研究指出，基线内聚感和其变化均与康复结局独立相关，尤其对整体健康和心理功能影响更强。这提示在康复干预中关注患者的内聚感可能改善他们的长期结果。
items.titleZh: 内聚感与康复结局：一项为期 3 年的纵向研究
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 3 年的纵向队列研究（n=601）发现，基线内聚感及其变化均与康复结局独立相关，其中与整体健康和心理功能的相关性更强。
items.curatedReasonEn: This 3-year prospective study indicates that both baseline sense of coherence and its changes are independently associated with rehabilitation outcomes, particularly for overall health and mental functioning. This suggests that focusing on patients' sense of coherence in rehabilitation interventions may improve their long-term results.
items.limitation: 研究对象是挪威的专业康复患者，结果外推到其他人群或医疗体系时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were patients undergoing specialized rehabilitation in Norway, so caution is needed when generalizing the findings to other populations or healthcare systems.

items.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A 3-week regimen of blood flow restriction (BFR) walking or low-load BFR resistance training significantly improved lower limb motor function and balance in 96 stroke patients compared to conventional training, with 34.4% of LL-BFR participants achieving MCID for FMA-LE vs 15.6% in control.
items.curatedReason: 为卒中患者带来希望：结合常规康复，BFR 训练（无论是 BFR 步行还是低负荷抗阻训练）能在中短期内显著改善下肢运动功能和平衡。可以考虑将 BFR 作为常规方案的有力补充。
items.titleZh: 血流限制训练对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 96 名卒中患者进行的为期 3 周的随机对照试验显示，血流限制 (BFR) 步行或低负荷 BFR 抗阻训练方案显著改善了患者的下肢运动功能和平衡，其中 34.4% 的低负荷 BFR 组患者达到 FMA-LE 的最小临床重要差异，而对照组为 15.6%。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, BFR training—either BFR-walking or low-load resistance training—significantly improves lower limb motor function and balance in the short to medium term when combined with conventional rehabilitation. Consider integrating BFR as a potent adjunct to standard protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，随访期仅 3 周，长期效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and a short 3-week follow-up, so long-term effects remain unclear.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.

items.title: Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F)
items.summary: CMS provides information on the Transparency in Coverage Final Rules (CMS 9882-F), which mandate health insurance issuers and group health plans to disclose pricing information.
items.curatedReason: 这是一份关于美国联邦医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）"透明度覆盖最终规则"的概况介绍。这些规则对保险公司和雇主健康计划的信息披露有直接要求，你应了解其潜在影响，尤其是对患者自付费用和报销机制的透明度。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于《透明度覆盖最终规则》（CMS 9882-F）
items.summaryZh: 美国联邦医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）发布了《透明度覆盖最终规则》（CMS 9882-F）的更多信息，这些规则要求健康保险公司和团体健康计划披露定价信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is an overview of the CMS "Transparency in Coverage Final Rules." These rules directly mandate information disclosure from insurers and employer health plans; you should understand their potential impact, especially regarding patient out-of-pocket costs and reimbursement transparency.

items.title: [World Report] Barriers to care: how new immigration rules are reshaping the US health workforce
items.summary: Volatile US immigration rules are raising concerns about staffing health and social care across the USA, potentially impacting the physical therapy workforce.
items.curatedReason: 美国移民政策的波动性正在直接影响医疗和社会护理领域的劳动力供应。这可能导致物理治疗师在招聘、人员配置和跨州执业方面遇到新的挑战，直接影响你的执业环境。
items.titleZh: 护理障碍：新移民法规如何重塑美国医疗劳动力
items.summaryZh: 报道指出，美国多变且限制性的移民法规正引发对全国医疗和社会护理人员配置的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: The volatility of US immigration policies is directly impacting the healthcare and social care workforce supply. This may lead to new challenges for physical therapists in recruitment, staffing, and interstate practice, directly affecting your practice environment.

items.title: The effects of route previewing on adaptive gait and gaze behaviour under cognitive dual-task conditions in older adults
items.summary: A study (n=39 older adults) found that route previewing before gait initiation attenuates the negative effects of cognitive load on adaptive gait, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps (p < .001) and improving gaze efficiency, likely by supporting visual motor planning.
items.curatedReason: 路线预演能有效缓解认知双任务情境下老年人适应性步态的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步，并改善注视行为。在对老年人进行步态训练时，将简单的视觉规划策略纳入干预方案，能显著提高他们在复杂环境中的行走安全性。
items.titleZh: 认知双任务条件下路线预演对老年人适应性步态和注视行为的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（39 名老年人）发现，步态启动前的路线预演能减弱认知负荷对适应性步态的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步（p < .001），并提高注视效率，可能通过支持视觉运动规划实现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Route previewing effectively mitigates the negative impact of cognitive dual-task conditions on adaptive gait in older adults, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps, and improving gaze behavior. When conducting gait training for older adults, incorporating simple visual planning strategies into intervention programs can significantly enhance their walking safety in complex environments.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了路线预演的即时效果，需要更长的随访来确认其长期效益和习惯性改变。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed the immediate effects of route previewing; longer follow-up is needed to confirm its long-term benefits and habitual changes.

items.title: New Regulations Make It Easier to Find, Compare, and Report Healthcare Pricing and Coverage Information
items.summary: CMS announced new regulations aimed at increasing transparency in healthcare pricing and coverage information, making it easier for consumers to find, compare, and report such data.
items.curatedReason: 美国CMS发布新规，旨在提高医疗服务定价和保险覆盖信息的透明度，让消费者更容易查找、比较和报告。虽然不是直接针对PT执业的单项政策，但作为美国医疗系统普遍性的定价和报销流程变化，这将间接影响 PT 诊所的患者沟通和收费合规。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于新法规使得医疗定价和覆盖信息更容易查找、比较和报告
items.summaryZh: CMS 宣布新法规，旨在提高医疗定价和覆盖信息的透明度，让消费者更容易查找、比较和报告相关数据。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS in the US has issued new regulations to enhance transparency in healthcare pricing and insurance coverage, making it easier for consumers to find, compare, and report information. While not a direct, single policy for PT practice, as a general change in the US healthcare system's pricing and reimbursement processes, this will indirectly affect PT clinics' patient communication and billing compliance.

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=11) explored barriers for adults aged 50+ with self-reported mobility, vision, or hearing impairment participating in community-based fall prevention exercise programs. Themes included lack of awareness/access, interconnected barriers, disability experiences, and program design challenges, revealing that participants often don't identify with programs due to stigma and misalignment.
items.curatedReason: 该定性研究揭示了老年残障人士不愿参与社区跌倒预防项目的原因，主要在于感知到的污名和项目设计不适切。这提示我们在推广和设计此类项目时，应更注重包容性、灵活性和身份认同，以提高依从性。
items.titleZh: “不适合我”：针对“渐进性残疾”老年人的社区跌倒预防运动项目
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=11）探讨了 50 岁及以上、自我报告有活动、视力或听力障碍的成年人参与社区跌倒预防运动项目的障碍。研究发现，由于污名化和项目错位，参与者常不认同这些项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals why older adults with disabilities are reluctant to participate in community-based fall prevention programs, primarily due to perceived stigma and unsuitable program designs. This suggests that when promoting and designing such programs, greater emphasis should be placed on inclusivity, flexibility, and identity affirmation to improve adherence.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=11），且参与者为自我报告残障的社区居住老年人，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (n=11) and reliance on self-reported disability among community-dwelling older adults may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Identifying Indicators of Advanced Levels of Clinical Competence in Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy: A Francophone Delphi Study
items.summary: A Francophone Delphi study (n=27 experts) identified 13 indicators of advanced clinical competence in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, with 10 achieving consensus on formulation. These indicators primarily reflected advanced clinical reasoning, such as real-time adaptation and decision-making under uncertainty, rather than standardized outcome attainment.
items.curatedReason: 这份Delphi研究（27位专家）提示，判断肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的高级临床能力，重点不在能否达到标准化结果，而在于临床推理的复杂性，比如不确定下的决策和实时应变能力。这意味着PT职业发展和晋升体系，应侧重评估这些进阶思维，而非仅仅是操作或结果达成。
items.titleZh: 识别肌肉骨骼物理治疗高级临床能力的指标：一项法语Delphi研究
items.summaryZh: 一项法语Delphi研究（27位专家）确定了肌肉骨骼物理治疗高级临床能力的 13 项指标，其中 10 项在表述上达成共识。这些指标主要反映高级临床推理，而非标准化结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Delphi study (27 experts) suggests that advanced musculoskeletal PT competence hinges on complex clinical reasoning, like decision-making under uncertainty and real-time adaptation, rather than just achieving standardized outcomes. For PT career advancement and evaluation, focus on assessing these higher-level cognitive skills, not just procedural proficiency or result attainment.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于法国讲法语的专家，可能限制了结果向其他文化或语言背景的物理治疗师的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to French-speaking experts in France, which may restrict the generalizability of the findings to physical therapists in other cultural or linguistic contexts.

items.title: Immediate effects of suspension walker support on locomotor behavior of pre-walking infants with Down syndrome
items.summary: A study on pre-walking infants with Down syndrome (DS) (ages 10-19 months) found that suspension walkers robustly increased locomotor behavior, including upright time and stepping rate. Most walker movement was caregiver-initiated, and infants stepped more while the walker was moving.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使没有长期练习，悬吊式助行器也能显著增加未习步的唐氏综合征婴儿的运动行为。这提示该设备在家用干预中的潜力，且强调了照护者在促进婴儿运动中的关键作用。
items.titleZh: 悬吊式助行器支撑对未习步唐氏综合征婴儿运动行为的即时影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对未习步唐氏综合征（DS）婴儿（10-19个月）的研究发现，悬吊式助行器能显著增加其运动行为，包括直立时间和步进频率。多数助行器移动由照护者启动，且婴儿在助行器移动时步进更多。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that suspended walkers can significantly increase locomotor behavior in pre-walking infants with Down syndrome, even without prolonged practice. This highlights the device's potential for home-based interventions and emphasizes the crucial role of caregivers in promoting infant movement.
items.limitation: 研究缺乏对照组，且未评估助行器使用的长期效果或对自主行走能力发展的潜在影响。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked a control group and did not assess the long-term effects of walker use or its potential impact on the development of independent walking abilities.

items.title: Identifying heterogeneous patterns of real-world upper limb use beyond motor severity: a cross-sectional sensor-based study in people with subacute stroke
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 101 subacute stroke patients used accelerometers and FMA-UL to identify six heterogeneous upper limb activity patterns, distinguishing between motor deficits, learned non-use, and UL inattention. Clinical variables like ARAT, MAL, and UL inattention were key differentiators.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用传感器数据识别出卒中后上肢真实世界使用模式的六种亚型，远远超越了单纯的运动功能评分。这提醒你在临床评估时，不能只看 FMA-UL，还要结合 MAL、ARAT 和注意力评估，才能更精准地为亚急性期卒中患者制定个性化康复方案，尤其要警惕“习得性废用”和“上肢不注意”带来的影响。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者上肢真实世界使用模式的异质性识别：一项超越运动严重程度的基于传感器的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对101名亚急性卒中患者的横断面研究，利用加速度计和 Fugl-Meyer 上肢评估（FMA-UL），识别出六种异质性上肢活动模式，区分了运动缺陷、习得性废用和上肢不注意。Action Research Arm Test (ARAT)、Motor Activity Log (MAL) 和上肢不注意是区分不同集群的关键临床变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study used sensor data to identify six real-world upper limb use subtypes after stroke, going beyond motor severity scores. This highlights the need to combine FMA-UL with MAL, ARAT, and inattention assessments for precise, individualized rehabilitation in subacute stroke, particularly for learned non-use and UL inattention.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法追踪不同亚型随时间的演变，且样本量为101人，可能会限制亚型模式的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to track subtype evolution over time, and the sample size of 101 participants may limit the generalizability of the identified patterns.

items.title: Effects of cluster-set vs. traditional resistance exercise with equated total rest on muscular performance, perceived fatigue, and cardiovascular responses in resistance-trained women
items.summary: A crossover RCT with 12 resistance-trained women found that cluster-set configurations (10-s and 30-s intra-set rest) significantly improved muscular endurance (18.4 ± 1.7 reps for CLS30 vs. 12.8 ± 1.2 for TRS) and reduced perceived fatigue compared to traditional sets, with equated total rest.
items.curatedReason: 在总休息时间相同的前提下，集束组训练能显著提高抗阻训练女性的肌肉耐力表现并降低主观疲劳和心血管负荷工作比。这意味着你可以考虑在女性抗阻训练中引入集束组，尤其是在不希望增加总体休息时间，但又想优化表现和减少疲劳感时。
items.titleZh: 集束组与传统抗阻训练在总休息时间相等条件下对女性肌肉表现、疲劳感和心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对12名抗阻训练女性进行的交叉随机对照试验发现，在总休息时间相等的情况下，集束组训练（组间休息10秒和30秒）与传统组训练相比，显著提高了肌肉耐力（CLS30组为18.4 ± 1.7次，传统组为12.8 ± 1.2次）并降低了疲劳感。
items.curatedReasonEn: With equated total rest, cluster-set configurations significantly improve muscular endurance and reduce perceived fatigue and cardiovascular load-to-work ratios in resistance-trained women. This suggests you can consider implementing cluster-sets in women's resistance training, especially when optimizing performance and reducing fatigue without increasing overall rest time.
items.limitation: 研究样本量仅为12名女性，且仅评估了急性效应，长期适应性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study involved only 12 women and assessed acute effects, so long-term adaptations are not yet clear.

items.title: Physical therapy care utilization and associated sociodemographic and clinical factors among noncommunicable diseases in the brazilian population: A cross-sectional, population-based study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study using the 2019 National Health Survey database (n=88,531 Brazilians with NCDs) found that stroke survivors had the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%; 95% CI: 15.4%, 18.7%). Follow-up by a healthcare professional was a common associated factor across stroke, chronic back pain, and chronic respiratory diseases.
items.curatedReason: 这次巴西的横断面研究提示，卒中幸存者的物理治疗利用率最高，达 17%。这表明医疗专业人员的持续随访可能直接影响慢性病患者获得治疗，值得我们在临床实践中加强随访策略。
items.titleZh: 巴西非传染性疾病人群物理治疗利用及其社会人口学和临床相关因素：一项横断面、基于人群的研究
items.summaryZh: 一项使用 2019 年国家健康调查数据库的横断面研究（88,531 名患有非传染性疾病的巴西人）发现，卒中幸存者的物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%；95% CI：15.4%, 18.7%）。由医疗专业人员随访是卒中、慢性背痛和慢性呼吸系统疾病患者共同的相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian cross-sectional study suggests stroke survivors have the highest PT utilization at 17%. This indicates that ongoing follow-up by a healthcare professional likely influences access to treatment for chronic conditions, underscoring the importance of strengthening follow-up strategies in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查的子分析，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖于自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This is a sub-analysis of a cross-sectional survey, which cannot establish causality, and the data rely on self-reporting.

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study
items.summary: A multicenter prospective study in Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, aims to identify the burden of fall-related injury and associated factors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in 2024.
items.curatedReason: 这项在埃塞俄比亚进行的多中心前瞻性研究量化了卒中幸存者的跌倒相关损伤负担，并识别了关键预测因素。尽管是区域性数据，但有助于理解卒中后跌倒风险的全球共性，并为针对性预防策略提供支持。
items.titleZh: 2024 年埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州综合专科医院卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州开展的多中心前瞻性研究旨在确定 2024 年在综合专科医院就诊的卒中幸存者中跌倒相关损伤的负担及其相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter prospective study in Ethiopia quantifies the burden of fall-related injuries among stroke survivors and identifies key predictors. While regional, it helps understand global commonalities in post-stroke fall risk and supports targeted prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究在埃塞俄比亚进行，其发现的预测因素可能不完全适用于其他地区的卒中幸存者。
items.limitationEn: Conducted in Ethiopia, the identified predictors may not be fully generalizable to stroke survivors in other regions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Validity and Reliability of Accelerometers to Evaluate Preschool-Aged Children’s Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior During Free-Living Condition: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review found accelerometers to be valid and reliable for assessing physical activity in preschool-aged children in free-living conditions, but less reliable for sedentary behavior, with no clear pooled direction.
items.curatedReason: 评估儿童身体活动和久坐行为需要可靠工具。本系统综述发现，加速度计在学龄前儿童自由生活条件下，对身体活动评估的效度和信度较高，但对久坐行为的可靠性较低。在实际应用中，要根据具体目的选择合适的参数和监测部位。
items.titleZh: 加速度计评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为的效度和信度：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，加速度计在学龄前儿童自由生活条件下评估身体活动具有较高的效度和信度，但在评估久坐行为方面可靠性较低，且未能报告汇总效应方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: Assessing physical activity and sedentary behavior in children requires reliable tools. This systematic review found that accelerometers have high validity and reliability for physical activity in preschool-aged children under free-living conditions, but lower reliability for sedentary behavior. Clinicians should select appropriate parameters and monitoring sites based on specific objectives.
items.limitation: 研究未提供荟萃分析结果，可能存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: The review did not report a pooled direction of effect and may have high heterogeneity.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: The experiences of physiotherapists regarding self-management practices for patients with non-specific chronic low back pain, South Africa: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 South African physiotherapists identified six themes regarding self-management for non-specific chronic low back pain, emphasizing the biopsychosocial model, patient beliefs, social factors, and interprofessional teamwork.
items.curatedReason: 对于非特异性慢性下腰痛的自我管理，这项针对 21 位南非物理治疗师的定性研究提示，需持续关注生物心理社会模型和患者信念。别忘了将社会因素和跨专业协作纳入你的临床考量，这可能有助于提升长期管理效果。
items.titleZh: 南非物理治疗师对非特异性慢性下腰痛患者自我管理实践的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非21名物理治疗师的定性研究，通过访谈识别了六个关于非特异性慢性下腰痛自我管理的主题，强调生物心理社会模型、患者信仰、社会因素和跨专业团队合作的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For non-specific chronic low back pain self-management, this qualitative study of 21 South African physiotherapists suggests a continued focus on the biopsychosocial model and patient beliefs. Remember to integrate social factors and interprofessional teamwork into your clinical considerations, as this may improve long-term management outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于南非林波波省的21名物理治疗师，结果可能不完全适用于其他地区或文化背景。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to 21 physiotherapists in the Limpopo province of South Africa, and its findings may not be fully generalizable to other regions or cultural contexts.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: The Role of Psychosocial Factors in Returning to Physical Activity and Sport Among Female Football Players After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review identified psychosocial factors influencing return to physical activity and sport among female football players after ACL injury. Uncertainty, fear, lack of confidence, and poor social support were perceived barriers, while confidence, motivation, strong social support, and athletic identity were facilitators.
items.curatedReason: 对 ACL 损伤后女性足球运动员，重返运动不能只盯着膝盖。这份综述提示，你需要主动评估她们的恐惧、不确定性和社会支持情况，因为这些心理社会因素与重返运动的成功与否密切相关。别忘了，除了体能，自信心和强烈的运动员身份认同也是关键。
items.titleZh: 心理社会因素在女性足球运动员前交叉韧带损伤后重返体育活动和运动中的作用：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别了前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤后女性足球运动员重返体育活动和运动的心理社会因素。不确定性、恐惧、缺乏信心和较差的社会支持被认为是障碍，而信心、动机、强大的社会支持和运动员身份是促进因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For female football players post-ACL injury, return to sport isn't just about the knee. This review suggests you must actively assess their fear, uncertainty, and social support, as these psychosocial factors are strongly linked to successful return to sport. Remember, beyond physical readiness, confidence and a strong athletic identity are also key.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限（7项），且异质性高，限制了结果的综合强度和可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (7) and their heterogeneity restrict the overall strength and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that 45% were adherent to home-based exercise therapy. Higher levels of physical activity before cLBP onset, lower intensity of cLBP, and lower burden of treatment were associated with higher adherence, while supervision showed no significant influence.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛患者，居家运动依从性是一个长期挑战。本研究发现监督模式对依从性无显著影响，但运动前活跃度、腰痛强度和治疗负担是关键预测因子。据此调整你对患者的教育和支持策略，尤其要关注那些依从性可能较低的患者群体。
items.titleZh: 非特异性慢性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列的横断面研究（ADHERE II）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成年人的横断面研究发现，45% 的患者居家运动治疗依从性良好。腰痛发作前较高的体力活动水平、较低的腰痛强度和较低的治疗负担与较高的依从性相关，而监督对依从性没有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to home-based exercise remains a long-standing challenge for patients with chronic low back pain. This study found no significant influence of supervision on adherence, but pre-onset physical activity, pain intensity, and treatment burden were key predictors. Adjust your patient education and support strategies accordingly, particularly for those at higher risk of non-adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且依从性测量依赖自我报告。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and adherence measurement relied on self-report.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title:
Physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy: a narrative review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A narrative review synthesized evidence on physiological determinants of endurance capacity in individuals with cerebral palsy, highlighting reduced cardiorespiratory fitness, autonomic dysregulation, restrictive ventilatory patterns, high energetic demands, and skeletal muscle alterations as key limiting factors. Impairments are more pronounced with greater functional limitations.
items.curatedReason: 脑瘫患者的耐力训练，不应简单照搬常规方案。这篇综述提醒我们，他们的心肺功能、呼吸模式、能量消耗及肌肉都存在显著改变，且功能限制越严重，这些障碍越明显。在设计康复计划时，必须针对性地考虑这些生理限制，才能真正提升他们的耐力能力。
items.titleZh: 脑瘫个体耐力能力的生理决定因素：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了脑瘫患者耐力能力的生理决定因素，强调心肺功能下降、自主神经功能紊乱、限制性通气模式、高能量需求和骨骼肌改变是主要限制因素。功能障碍越严重的个体，其耐力受损越显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: Endurance training for individuals with cerebral palsy shouldn't simply mimic standard protocols. This review highlights that their cardiorespiratory fitness, ventilatory patterns, energetic demands, and skeletal muscle are significantly altered, with impairments worsening with greater functional limitations. When designing rehabilitation plans, you must specifically account for these physiological limitations to genuinely improve their endurance capacity.
items.limitation: 作为一篇叙述性综述，其证据综合方法不如系统综述严谨，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, its evidence synthesis methods are less rigorous than a systematic review, potentially introducing selection bias.

items.title: Paired cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes across repeated anodal transcranial direct current stimulation in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory within-subject study
items.summary: An exploratory within-subject study of 14 Parkinson's disease patients receiving repeated anodal tDCS identified short-term clinical improvements (UPDRS-III, NMSS-K, MoCA-K) and specific cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes, including increases in purine- and tyrosine/levodopa-related metabolites and alterations in non-polar lipids. The study lacked a sham control.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究首次提示帕金森病患者重复经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）可能引起的脑脊液代谢物变化。虽然缺乏对照组，不能确证疗效，但它为未来设计更大规模的随机对照试验提供了关键的可行性数据和潜在的生物标志物靶点，这有助于你跟进非侵入性脑刺激疗法的进展。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病重复阳极经颅直流电刺激前后脑脊液代谢组学变化：一项探索性受试者内研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 14 名帕金森病患者接受重复阳极经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）的探索性研究显示，患者临床症状（UPDRS-III、NMSS-K 评分下降，MoCA-K 评分增加）和脑脊液代谢组学发生短期变化，包括嘌呤和酪氨酸/左旋多巴相关代谢物增加，以及非极性脂质改变。本研究缺乏安慰剂对照。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study offers the first insights into potential cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes following repeated transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) in Parkinson's disease. While lacking a sham control, it provides crucial feasibility data and candidate molecular targets for future randomized controlled trials, helping you track advancements in non-invasive brain stimulation therapies.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本探索性研究，缺乏安慰剂对照组，无法确定治疗的有效性和因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This small-sample exploratory study lacks a sham control group, preventing determination of treatment efficacy or causality.

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study in Ethiopia (N=269) found the prevalence of fall-related injury among stroke survivors to be 79.9% (95% CI: 75.1-84.4). Age >65, rural residence, and injuries during walking and turning were significant predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心观察研究揭示了埃塞俄比亚卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤的高发生率（79.9%），并指出了高龄、农村居住和步行/转弯时的活动是主要预测因素。临床实践中，你需要特别关注这些高风险群体，加强跌倒风险评估和预防干预，尤其在患者进行步行和转弯活动时。
items.titleZh: 2024年埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 埃塞俄比亚一项纳入269名卒中幸存者的多中心横断面研究发现，跌倒相关损伤的发生率为79.9% (95% CI: 75.1-84.4)。年龄超过65岁、农村居住以及在步行和转弯时发生损伤是显著的预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter observational study reveals a high incidence of fall-related injuries (79.9%) among stroke survivors in Ethiopia and identifies older age, rural residence, and activities like walking and turning as key predictors. In clinical practice, you should pay special attention to these high-risk groups, enhancing fall risk assessment and prevention interventions, especially during ambulation and turning activities.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系，且数据来自埃塞俄比亚的特定医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and data from specific hospitals in Ethiopia limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes pulmonary rehabilitation research between January 2021 and May 2026, highlighting expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, alternative PR models, and economic benefits, while noting ongoing challenges in access and long-term maintenance.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了肺康复研究的最新进展，尤其强调了其在稳定期COPD之外的广泛适用性（如ILD、肺动脉高压、肺癌）。它提示你，在评估心肺功能受损患者时，应更积极地考虑将肺康复纳入治疗方案，并探索中心化以外的多种交付模式。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了2021年1月至2026年5月期间的肺康复研究，强调其范围已扩展到稳定期慢阻肺以外的多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并探讨了替代康复模式和经济效益，同时指出了长期维持和可及性方面的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review highlights recent advances in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research, emphasizing its expanded applicability beyond stable COPD to conditions like ILD, pulmonary hypertension, and lung cancer. It suggests you should more actively consider PR in treatment plans for patients with cardiopulmonary impairments and explore diverse delivery models beyond center-based programs.

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This article provides an appraisal of a clinical practice guideline concerning the physical therapy management of children diagnosed with developmental coordination disorder (DCD).
items.curatedReason: 你需要知道，这份针对DCD儿童物理治疗的临床实践指南（CPG）质量如何，以及它的推荐强度。这份评估能帮你理清DCD管理中的哪些建议有坚实证据支持，哪些还不足，从而更精准地应用治疗策略。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 本文对一份关于发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童物理治疗管理的临床实践指南进行了评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: You need to know the quality of this clinical practice guideline (CPG) for physical therapy management of children with DCD, and the strength of its recommendations. This appraisal helps you discern which DCD management strategies are evidence-based and which are not, allowing for more precise application of treatment.

items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: This single-center, single-blind RCT (n=30) found that both rTMS and iTBS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved lower-extremity motor function, SCIM III scores, and 10 MWT in chronic SCI patients, with median LEMS improvements of 4.0 and 5.0, respectively, versus 0.0 for sham, at 4-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性脊髓损伤患者，iTBS 和 rTMS 结合机器人康复均能改善下肢功能，效果与假刺激有显著差异。但两种主动方案之间效果无差异，提示选择时可根据患者具体情况和可及资源来定。
items.titleZh: iTBS 和 rTMS 联合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者步态和下肢运动功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项单中心、单盲随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）和间歇性θ字串爆发刺激（iTBS）联合机器人康复，均能改善下肢运动功能、SCIM III 评分和 10 米步行测试表现，其中 rTMS 组和 iTBS 组的 LEMS 中位改善值分别为 4.0 和 5.0，而假刺激组为 0.0。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both iTBS and rTMS combined with robotic rehabilitation significantly improved lower extremity function in chronic SCI patients compared to sham. However, no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols, suggesting patient-specific factors and resource availability can guide selection.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心、单盲设计，且样本量较小（n=30），结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center, single-blind trial with a small sample size (n=30), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=71) comparing short-rest interval (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set (3×9 RT) resistance training combined with endurance training in cardiac rehab patients found similar improvements in VO₂peak, 30-s sit-to-stand, and total lean mass. However, 3/7 RT resulted in greater improvements in quadriceps isokinetic strength (+23±20 N·m vs. +11±22 N·m; P=0.022).
