items.summaryZh: CMS 宣布为阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州在公共卫生紧急情况期间提供新的资源和灵活性。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has announced resources and flexibilities to assist with public health emergencies in Alabama and Florida. If you practice in these states, monitor the CMS website for specific policy details, as this may affect your reimbursement and practice procedures.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (1,177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49), but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI was associated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). Population type moderated the effects of training on Cw (p=0.043).
items.curatedReason: 慢性运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本（g=0.49），但在卒中患者中，其改善效果并不显著（g=0.24, p=0.065）。此外，BMI越高，训练对步行代谢成本的改善效果越小（β=-0.20）。这意味着，在健康人群中，运动训练是提高步行效率的有效手段；而对于卒中患者，其效益可能较小，且肥胖会进一步削弱这种效果，设计方案时务必考虑这些差异。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项研究（1,177 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，慢性体力运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本 (g=0.49)，但在卒中患者中无显著改善 (g=0.24, p=0.065)。较高的 BMI 与步行代谢成本干预效果较小相关 (β=-0.20)。人群类型调节了训练对步行代谢成本的影响 (p=0.043)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49) but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI also correlated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). This means exercise training is effective for improving walking economy in healthy populations, but its benefits might be smaller for stroke patients, and obesity further attenuates this effect. Be sure to consider these differences when designing intervention plans.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究存在中度异质性，且卒中、多发性硬化症、帕金森病等神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This review includes studies with moderate heterogeneity, and the sample sizes for neurological conditions like stroke, MS, and Parkinson's disease are relatively small.

related.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.

items.title: Predictive value of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex monitoring for postoperative voiding dysfunction after lumbosacral spine surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring found it feasible (94% success rate) and predictive of postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. BCR showed moderate sensitivity (62%) and high specificity (99%), with a high negative predictive value of 94% for POVD.
items.curatedReason: 术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍（POVD）具有高特异性和阴性预测值。这提示您在参与腰骶椎术前评估和术后康复计划时，可将 BCR 监测结果作为辅助参考，识别 POVD 高风险患者，并协助制定个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 术中球海绵体反射监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍的预测价值：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项关于术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，该方法可行（成功率 94%），且能预测腰骶椎手术后的排尿功能障碍（POVD）。BCR 对 POVD 表现出中度敏感性（62%）和高特异性（99%），阴性预测值为 94%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring shows high specificity and negative predictive value for postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. This suggests that when participating in pre- and post-operative rehabilitation planning for lumbosacral spine surgery, you can use BCR monitoring results as an auxiliary reference to identify high-risk POVD patients and help develop individualized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限，且研究间存在异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of RCTs included and the heterogeneity among studies may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Return to Competition and Career Sustainability After Primary ACL Reconstruction in Football: A Nationwide Cohort Study of Long-Term Participation
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of 10,836 football players after primary ACLR found a 58.5% return to competition (RTC) rate. Post-RTC career sustainability (median 31 matches over 3 seasons) was greatest among top-level players (97 matches over 5 seasons) and men (33 matches over 4 seasons vs. women's 29 matches over 3 seasons). RTC alone provides an incomplete description of participation.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员在初次 ACLR 术后重返赛场（RTC）率达 58.5%，但职业生涯持续性因竞技水平和性别而异。这提示您在 ACLR 康复中，RTC 并非终点，应关注术后长期参与度，并根据患者的竞技水平和性别制定差异化的重返运动及职业可持续性策略。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返赛场及职业生涯可持续性：一项全国性长期参与队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10,836 名足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后的全国性队列研究发现，重返赛场 (RTC) 率为 58.5%。RTC 后职业生涯可持续性（中位数 3 个赛季 31 场比赛）在顶级水平运动员（5 个赛季 97 场比赛）和男性（4 个赛季 33 场比赛对比女性 3 个赛季 29 场比赛）中最高。RTC 本身不能完全描述长期参与度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The return to competition (RTC) rate after primary ACLR in football players is 58.5%, but career sustainability varies by competitive level and sex. This suggests that in ACLR rehabilitation, RTC is not the endpoint; you should focus on long-term participation and tailor return-to-sport and career sustainability strategies based on the player's competitive level and sex.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: The effect of adding virtual reality-based rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy on pain, function and static balance control in patients with total knee arthroplasty during the acute rehabilitation phase: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=52) found that adding VR-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy after total knee arthroplasty significantly improved WOMAC scores and pain at post-treatment and one-month follow-up (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36), and static balance (p < 0.001, η² = 0.23 for mediolateral mean velocity) compared to conventional therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 在全膝关节置换术（TKA）的急性康复期，虚拟现实（VR）疗法能额外改善患者的疼痛、功能和静态平衡。这提示您可考虑将 VR 引入 TKA 术后早期康复方案，作为传统物理治疗的补充。
items.titleZh: 在全膝关节置换术急性康复期，将虚拟现实康复加入常规物理治疗对疼痛、功能和静态平衡控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=52）发现，在全膝关节置换术后，与单独的常规物理治疗相比，在常规物理治疗中加入基于虚拟现实的疗法能显著改善治疗后和一个月随访时的 WOMAC 评分和疼痛（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36），以及静态平衡（p < 0.001, 内外侧平均速度 η² = 0.23）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality (VR) therapy can provide additional benefits in pain, function, and static balance during the acute rehabilitation phase following total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This suggests you might consider incorporating VR into early post-TKA rehabilitation programs as a supplement to conventional physiotherapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心小样本研究（52 名患者），随访期短，且未评估长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a small sample size (52 patients), short follow-up, and did not assess long-term efficacy.

items.title: Promoting arm movement practice with a novel wheelchair armrest early after stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=35) found that a novel wheelchair-mounted rehabilitation device, Boost, was feasible and allowed stroke inpatients to complete thousands of unsupervised upper extremity movements. While no significant between-group clinical differences were found at 3-month follow-up, the Boost group showed a trend toward greater UEFM improvement immediately post-intervention (11.8 vs. 6.9 points, p = 0.06), especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.curatedReason: 新型轮椅扶手辅助设备 Boost 在卒中早期住院康复中能促进患者完成数千次上肢运动，对轻度损伤患者短期效果更佳。这提示您可考虑引入此类设备，增加患者在无直接监督下的运动量，从而优化康复效率，尤其对于损伤程度较轻的患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中早期使用新型轮椅扶手辅助促进手臂运动训练：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=35）发现，新型轮椅辅助康复设备 Boost 在卒中住院患者中可行，并使其在无监督下完成数千次上肢运动。虽然 3 个月随访时未发现显著的组间临床差异，但 Boost 组在干预后上肢 Fugl-Meyer 评分有更大改善趋势（11.8 vs. 6.9 分, p = 0.06），尤其对轻度损伤患者更明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: The novel wheelchair armrest device, Boost, can facilitate thousands of upper extremity movements in early post-stroke inpatient rehabilitation, with better short-term outcomes for less severely impaired patients. This suggests you could consider incorporating such devices to increase patient exercise volume without direct supervision, optimizing rehabilitation efficiency, especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（35 名患者），随访期短，且未达到显著的组间临床差异，尚需更大规模 RCT 验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (35 patients), short follow-up, and did not achieve significant between-group clinical differences, necessitating validation in larger RCTs.

items.title: Effects of training with a soft wearable robot (Myosuit®) on the walking ability of patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: A randomized controlled study (N=30) found that gait training using Myosuit®, a soft wearable robot, did not show overall significant differences compared to a control group in chronic stroke patients. However, subgroup analysis showed significant improvements in the 10-m walking test, Berg balance scale, and gait velocity for Myosuit® users with better baseline gait function (FAC 4).
items.curatedReason: 使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练可能对慢性卒中、且步态功能较好的患者的步态功能有改善作用。这提示您在引入康复机器人时，应考虑患者的基线步态功能水平，以实现更精准的干预。
items.titleZh: 使用软性可穿戴机器人（Myosuit®）训练对慢性卒中患者步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照研究（N=30）发现，与对照组相比，使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练对慢性卒中患者总体上未显示显著差异。然而，亚组分析显示，基线步态功能较好（FAC 4）的 Myosuit® 使用者在 10 米步行测试、Berg 平衡量表和步速方面有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gait training with the soft wearable robot Myosuit® may improve gait function in chronic stroke patients with better baseline gait function. This suggests that when introducing rehabilitation robots, you should consider patients' baseline gait function levels for more precise interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（30 名患者），且总体结果未见显著差异，仅在亚组分析中显示出效应。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (30 patients), showed no significant overall differences, and only revealed effects in subgroup analysis.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored healthcare professionals' (HCPs) and people with aphasia's (PWA) experiences with a novel digital communication aid. HCPs valued the app for person-centered care but faced constraints from clinical demands and lack of healthcare system support, suggesting that multi-level systems reform is needed to facilitate communication aid adoption for PWA.
items.curatedReason: 沟通障碍是卒中后失语患者面临的关键挑战，而数字沟通辅助工具的使用虽有价值，却受到临床、沟通和情感等多重需求的限制。在引入此类工具时，需意识到仅靠工具本身不足以解决问题，更重要的是医疗系统层面的支持和文化转变，例如增加培训和资源配置。
items.titleZh: “这很重要，但有代价”：医疗专业人员和失语症患者描述了什么影响了新型数字沟通辅助工具的使用
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了医护人员 (HCP) 和失语症患者 (PWA) 使用新型数字沟通辅助工具的经验。HCP 认为该应用对以患者为中心的护理很有价值，但受到临床需求和医疗系统支持不足的限制，这表明需要多层面的系统改革来促进失语症患者沟通辅助工具的采用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Communication barriers are a key challenge for post-stroke aphasia patients, and while digital communication aids are valuable, their use is limited by a complex interplay of clinical, communicative, and emotional demands. When introducing such tools, recognize that the tool itself is insufficient; systemic support and cultural shifts, such as increased training and resource allocation, are more crucial.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性观察性研究，样本量很小（10 名医疗专业人员和 3 名失语症患者），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative observational study had a very small sample size (10 HCPs and 3 PWAs), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summary: This longitudinal observational study (n=47 at 3-months, n=39 at 12-months) found that for adults with spinal cord injury, positive appraisals of life transition events (e.g., return-to-work, driving) and coping efficacy were consistently and positively associated with better quality of life (EUROHIS-QoL-8) at 3 and 12 months post-discharge, after controlling for event occurrence.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，生命转折事件（如重返工作或驾驶）的积极评价以及应对能力的自我效能感，与出院后 12 个月的良好生活质量显著相关。这意味着你需要关注患者对这些事件的主观意义和应对策略，通过提升自我效能和提供资源，帮助患者更好地适应，而不仅仅是关注功能恢复本身。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月生命转折事件评价与生活质量的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向观察性研究（3个月随访时n=47，12个月随访时n=39）发现，对于脊髓损伤成年患者，对生命转折事件（如重返工作、驾驶）的积极评价和应对效能感，在控制了事件发生后，与出院后3个月和12个月的较好生活质量（EUROHIS-QoL-8）持续呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For spinal cord injury patients, positive appraisals of life transition events (e.g., returning to work or driving) and self-efficacy in coping are significantly associated with better quality of life up to 12 months post-discharge. This means you should focus on the subjective meaning patients attribute to these events and their coping strategies, enhancing self-efficacy and providing resources to help them adapt, beyond just focusing on functional recovery.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（3 个月随访时 n=47，12 个月时 n=39），且为单中心研究，限制了结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=47 at 3-month, n=39 at 12-month follow-up) and was single-center, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: An 11-year analysis of Australia's physiotherapy workforce (2013-2023) showed a 70.5% increase in physiotherapists, from 21,046 to 35,889, but an persistent maldistribution with 81.0% practicing in metropolitan areas in 2023. Males were 15% less likely to practice in regional centers than females (OR 0.85, p < .001), while Indigenous physiotherapists were 85% more likely to practice in regional centers (OR 1.85, p < .001).
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力在过去 11 年增长了 70.5%，但乡村和偏远地区的分配不均问题依然存在。规划师们可以以此为依据，更精准地制定激励措施和支持策略，以吸引更多 PT 到这些地区执业。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力的趋势：变化与未来影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力 11 年（2013-2023）的分析显示，物理治疗师数量从 21,046 增至 35,889，增长了 70.5%，但劳动力在乡村和偏远地区的分配不均问题依然存在，2023 年 81.0% 的 PT 在大都市执业。男性在区域中心执业的可能性比女性低 15%，而原住民物理治疗师在区域中心执业的可能性高 85%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australia's physiotherapy workforce grew by 70.5% over 11 years, yet maldistribution in rural and remote areas persists. Planners can use this data to precisely design incentives and support strategies to attract more PTs to practice in these regions.
items.limitation: 本研究基于横断面数据和回顾性分析，未能探讨劳动力流动的动态原因。
items.limitationEn: This study relies on cross-sectional data and retrospective analysis, limiting its ability to explore dynamic reasons for workforce mobility.

items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A four-year prospective cohort study with 92 older adults with atraumatic massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs) found that most patients (95-100%) achieved minimal clinically important differences (MCID) with nonoperative treatment, persisting until 4 years. Longer symptom duration (β = -1.3; 95% CI = -1.7 to -0.8) and smoking (β = -8.8; 95% CI = -13.2 to -4.4) were associated with worse shoulder function.
items.curatedReason: 对于老年、无法修复的巨大肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）患者，非手术治疗是有效的长期方案，95-100%的患者在四年内能达到MCID。别再犹豫将非手术治疗作为此类患者的一线选择，但要提醒患者，症状持续时间长和吸烟可能导致更差的功能预后。
items.titleZh: 老年不可修复巨大肩袖撕裂患者的长期临床结局及影响因素：一项四年前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对92名老年非创伤性不可修复巨大肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）患者进行的四年前瞻性队列研究发现，大多数患者（95-100%）通过非手术治疗达到了临床最小重要差异（MCID），效果持续至四年。症状持续时间越长（β = -1.3; 95% CI = -1.7至-0.8）和吸烟（β = -8.8; 95% CI = -13.2至-4.4）与较差的肩关节功能相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs), nonoperative treatment is an effective long-term option, with 95-100% of patients achieving MCID over four years. Don't hesitate to consider nonoperative management as a first-line option for these patients, but be aware that longer symptom duration and smoking may be associated with worse functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性队列研究，且大部分患者（76/92）在3个月内表现出临床改善，可能存在选择偏倚，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study, and the majority of patients (76/92) showed clinical improvement within 3 months, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 23 studies (out of 5,220 identified) found no consistent evidence that dry needling parameters (number of sessions, trigger points, local twitch responses) influenced its effectiveness for neck pain. Meta-regressions did not identify these parameters as moderators (QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 to QM = 3.17, p = 0.205).
items.curatedReason: 干针治疗颈痛时，目前没有证据表明治疗参数（如疗程次数、激痛点数量、局部抽搐反应）会影响疗效。所以，你暂时不需要纠结于这些具体剂量参数，重点仍应放在干针的整体临床效果和患者的个体反应上。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其止痛效果？一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含23项研究（从5,220项中筛选）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，没有一致证据表明干针治疗参数（疗程次数、触发点数量、局部抽搐反应）会影响其对颈痛的疗效。荟萃回归分析也未发现这些参数是疗效的调节因素（QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 至 QM = 3.17, p = 0.205）。
items.curatedReasonEn: There is currently no evidence that dry needling parameters (e.g., number of sessions, number of trigger points, local twitch responses) influence its effectiveness for neck pain. Therefore, you do not need to overthink these specific dosage parameters for now; continue to focus on the overall clinical effect of dry needling and individual patient responses.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的大部分文献报告不完整且存在高偏倚风险，荟萃分析存在显著异质性，导致无法得出可靠的剂量-反应关系。
items.limitationEn: Most included literature had incomplete reporting and high risk of bias, and the meta-analysis showed substantial heterogeneity, preventing identification of a reliable dose-response relationship.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A machine learning model using Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) was developed to predict walking ability in 148 nontraumatic spinal cord injury patients. It achieved an AUC of 0.91 (95% CI: 0.77-1.00) on internal testing and 0.81 accuracy (95% CI: 0.68-0.92) on temporal external validation (n=37). Key predictors included lower limb muscle strength and age.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究初步开发了一个机器学习模型，用于预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。虽然模型在内部和外部验证中表现良好，但目前仍处于探索阶段，你在临床上不应将其作为现成的工具。它提示了未来精准康复评估的潜力，但仍需等待更大规模、多中心研究的验证。
items.titleZh: 基于时间验证的机器学习模型预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力
items.summaryZh: 一个使用梯度提升决策树（GBDT）的机器学习模型被开发用于预测148名非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。该模型在内部测试中实现了0.91的AUC（95% CI: 0.77-1.00），在时间外部验证（n=37）中实现了0.81的准确率（95% CI: 0.68-0.92）。关键预测因素包括下肢肌力和年龄。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study preliminarily developed a machine learning model to predict walking ability in patients with nontraumatic spinal cord injury. While the model showed promising performance in internal and external validation, it is still exploratory, and you should not use it as a ready-to-use clinical tool. It suggests the potential for future precise rehabilitation assessment but requires validation in larger, multicenter studies.
items.limitation: 本模型在单中心、相对较小的患者群体（148例开发，37例外部验证）中开发和验证，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed and validated in a single center with a relatively small patient cohort (148 for development, 37 for external validation), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, an 8-item, 3-factor measure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, and Reflection), demonstrated excellent psychometric properties (CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031) among 310 Spanish pediatric physical therapists for assessing family-centered educational practices.
items.curatedReason: 这份8项的“物理治疗中的家长教育量表”（PEP）在西班牙儿科物理治疗师中验证了其评估家庭中心教育实践的优异心理测量学特性。你可以用这个量表来定期评估和指导自己在与6岁以下儿童家庭合作、赋能和反思方面的表现，从而系统性地提升家庭中心化护理质量。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗中家长教育量表的心理测量学评估：一项关于儿科物理治疗中家庭中心化教育实践的简短测量工具
items.summaryZh: “物理治疗中的家长教育量表”（PEP）是一项包含8个条目、3个维度（协作、能力建设和反思）的测量工具，在310名西班牙儿科物理治疗师中表现出优秀的心理测量学特性（CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031），用于评估以家庭为中心的教育实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: The 8-item Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale has demonstrated excellent psychometric properties among Spanish pediatric physical therapists for assessing family-centered educational practices. You can use this scale to regularly evaluate and guide your performance in collaborating with, building capacity in, and reflecting with families of children under 6 years of age, thereby systematically improving the quality of family-centered care.
items.limitation: 本研究为工具性横断面研究，数据来源于西班牙的物理治疗师，可能存在文化和实践背景的局限性。
items.limitationEn: This instrumental cross-sectional study collected data from physical therapists in Spain, which may introduce cultural and practice context limitations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Medicare Program; Implementation of Sections 6219, 6220, and 6224 of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (CMS-4214-P)
items.summary: CMS announced a proposed rule for the implementation of Sections 6219, 6220, and 6224 of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, signaling potential changes to Medicare program operations and payment policies.
items.curatedReason: CMS 正在发布一项拟议规则，旨在实施《2026年综合拨款法案》中的第6219、6220和6224节。这些条款可能涉及 Medicare 支付政策和执业范围的重大调整，对物理治疗服务的报销和合规性有直接影响。你需要详细审阅拟议规则，以了解可能的变化并做好准备。
items.titleZh: Medicare 项目；《2026年综合拨款法案》第6219、6220和6224节的实施（CMS-4214-P）
items.summaryZh: CMS 公布了一项关于实施《2026年综合拨款法案》第6219、6220和6224节的拟议规则，预示着 Medicare 项目运营和支付政策可能发生变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is issuing a proposed rule to implement Sections 6219, 6220, and 6224 of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026. These provisions may involve significant adjustments to Medicare payment policies and scope of practice, directly impacting reimbursement and compliance for physical therapy services. You need to review the proposed rule in detail to understand potential changes and prepare accordingly.

items.title: CMS Proposes Reforms to Strengthen Transparency and Affordability in Medicare Advantage and Part D
items.summary: CMS proposes reforms to strengthen transparency and affordability in Medicare Advantage and Part D programs, which could impact physical therapy reimbursement and patient access.
items.curatedReason: CMS 提议改革 Medicare Advantage (MA) 和 Part D 计划，旨在加强透明度和可负担性。这些变化可能影响 MA 计划下物理治疗服务的报销规则、患者自付费用和网络准入，你需要密切关注最终规则，评估其对你诊所运营和患者转诊的影响。
items.titleZh: CMS 提议改革以加强 Medicare Advantage 和 Part D 的透明度和可负担性
items.summaryZh: CMS 提议改革以增强 Medicare Advantage 和 Part D 计划的透明度和可负担性，这可能影响物理治疗的报销和患者可及性。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is proposing reforms to Medicare Advantage (MA) and Part D plans, aiming to strengthen transparency and affordability. These changes may impact reimbursement rules, patient out-of-pocket costs, and network access for physical therapy services under MA plans. You should closely monitor the final rule to assess its impact on your clinic's operations and patient referrals.

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal Cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 48 nursing professionals in a spinal cord injury rehabilitation center found 87.5% experienced patient-perpetrated sexual harassment within 12 months, with verbal harassment being the most prevalent and severe.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对脊髓损伤康复中心护士的调查揭示了患者性骚扰的普遍性，其中言语骚扰最为常见且严重。作为物理治疗师，你在执业中与患者的密切接触可能也会面临类似风险，应提高警惕，并在机构层面推动相关培训和支持机制。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士遭受性骚扰的经历
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤康复中心48名护理人员的横断面调查发现，87.5%的受访者在过去12个月内遭受过患者的性骚扰，其中言语性骚扰最为普遍和严重。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey on nurses in a SCI rehabilitation center reveals the prevalence of patient-perpetrated sexual harassment, with verbal harassment being the most common and severe. As a physical therapist, your close contact with patients in practice may also expose you to similar risks; you should be vigilant and advocate for relevant training and support mechanisms at the institutional level.
items.limitation: 本研究为单一中心的横断面调查，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, cross-sectional survey, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: How Sensory and Motor Components Shape the Neurological Level of Injury
items.summary: This study assesses the contributions of light touch, pinprick, and motor function in determining the neurological level of injury (NLI) and how omitting these components affects NLI and ASIA Impairment Scale classification, aiming to inform evidence-based recommendations.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在确定神经损伤平面（NLI）和 ASIA 损伤量表（AIS）分类时，轻触、针刺和运动功能三者缺一不可。任何一项评估的缺失都可能导致不准确的 NLI 和 AIS 分类，所以务必进行全面的感觉和运动评估。
items.titleZh: 感觉和运动成分如何影响神经损伤平面
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了轻触、针刺和运动功能对神经损伤平面（NLI）确定的贡献，以及省略这些成分如何影响NLI和美国脊髓损伤协会（ASIA）损伤量表分类，旨在为循证建议提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that light touch, pinprick, and motor function are all crucial for accurate neurological level of injury (NLI) and ASIA Impairment Scale (AIS) classification. Omitting any one of these assessments may lead to inaccurate NLI and AIS classifications; therefore, comprehensive sensory and motor evaluations are essential.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $92 Million to Coordinate Rural Hospital Networks, Improve Maternal Care, and Expand Medical Services Across Ohio
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced $92 million to coordinate rural hospital networks, improve maternal care, and expand medical services across Ohio.
items.curatedReason: 美国政府宣布向俄亥矶州拨款，用于协调农村医院网络、改善孕产妇护理和扩大医疗服务。这对俄亥俄州的农村医疗基础设施建设和可及性是利好，可能为当地物理治疗师带来更多执业机会。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款9200万美元用于协调俄亥俄州农村医院网络、改善孕产妇护理和扩大医疗服务
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布向俄亥俄州拨款，旨在协调农村医院网络、改善孕产妇护理并扩大医疗服务。
items.curatedReasonEn: The U.S. government announced $92 million for Ohio to coordinate rural hospital networks, improve maternal care, and expand medical services. This is a positive development for rural healthcare infrastructure and accessibility in Ohio, potentially creating more practice opportunities for local physical therapists.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces More Than $11 Million to Strengthen Rural EMS and Expand Mobile Healthcare Across New Hampshire
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced over $11 million to strengthen rural EMS and expand mobile healthcare across New Hampshire.
items.curatedReason: 美国政府宣布向新罕布什尔州拨款，用于加强农村急救医疗服务（EMS）和扩大移动医疗服务。虽然主要针对 EMS，但移动医疗的扩展可能为物理治疗师在农村地区提供远程或社区服务带来新的机会。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款逾1100万美元以加强新罕布什尔州的农村急救医疗服务并扩大移动医疗
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布向新罕布什尔州拨款，用于加强农村急救医疗服务（EMS）和扩大移动医疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: The U.S. government announced over $11 million for New Hampshire to strengthen rural EMS and expand mobile healthcare. While primarily for EMS, the expansion of mobile healthcare might create new opportunities for physical therapists to provide remote or community-based services in rural areas.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: An umbrella review of 28 meta-analyses found that exercise-containing interventions consistently supported improvements in muscle function and physical performance in older adults, particularly for fall-related outcomes. Nutrition-only interventions showed modest benefits for muscle mass in selected vulnerable populations, while combined interventions improved some strength and functional outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述有力地支持了运动干预在改善老年人肌肉功能和身体表现方面的作用，尤其是对跌倒相关结局。你可以自信地推荐以运动为基础的预防策略，但对纯营养干预的益处则要谨慎。
items.titleZh: 运动、营养和联合干预对老年人肌肉功能和身体表现的证据可信度和强度：一项随机对照试验荟萃分析的伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 28 项荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，包含运动的干预措施在改善老年人肌肉功能和身体表现方面始终有证据支持，尤其是在跌倒相关结局方面。纯营养干预在特定脆弱人群的肌肉量方面显示出适度益处，而联合干预则改善了一些力量和功能结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strongly supports the role of exercise interventions in improving muscle function and physical performance in older adults, especially for fall-related outcomes. You can confidently recommend exercise-based prevention strategies, but be cautious about the benefits of nutrition-only interventions.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述存在方法学质量混杂（18 项低或极低质量），且存在综述重叠和临床异质性，部分大效应量来自小样本研究，结果解释需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The included systematic reviews had mixed methodological quality (18 low or critically low quality), with review overlap and clinical heterogeneity. Some large effect sizes came from small sample studies, requiring cautious interpretation.

items.title: The role of core stability training in improving balance and poomsae technique quality in taekwondo poomsae athletes with neuromuscular control deficits with trunk involvement: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: An 8-week randomized controlled trial (N=29 male taekwondo athletes) found that core stability training significantly improved static and dynamic balance, trunk muscle endurance (ηp² = 0.38–0.84, P < 0.001), and some sport-specific performance measures compared to regular training.
items.curatedReason: 核心稳定性训练能显著提高跆拳道品势运动员的平衡和躯干肌肉耐力，并对特定运动表现有额外改善。对于你需要训练的、有躯干神经肌肉控制缺陷的爆发性运动项目运动员，可以把核心训练纳入其常规方案。
items.titleZh: 核心稳定性训练在改善躯干受累神经肌肉控制缺陷的跆拳道品势运动员平衡和品势技术质量中的作用：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的随机对照试验（N=29 名男性跆拳道运动员）发现，核心稳定性训练显著改善了静态和动态平衡、躯干肌肉耐力（ηp² = 0.38–0.84, P < 0.001）以及一些运动特异性表现指标，优于常规训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Core stability training significantly improved balance and trunk muscle endurance in taekwondo poomsae athletes, with additional improvements in selected sport-specific performance. For athletes with trunk neuromuscular control deficits in explosive sports, you can incorporate core training into their regular programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（29 名男性运动员），且集中于特定人群和运动类型，结果推广至其他人群和运动时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study had a relatively small sample size (29 male athletes) and focused on a specific population and sport type, so the results should be generalized with caution to other populations and sports.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary study (N=7 chronic stroke) found that a single session of high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased FDS MEP amplitudes by ~22.3% in chronic stroke, though not statistically significant, suggesting potential for enhancing corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: HD-tACS 联合机器人辅助手部练习有望提高卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。这为卒中康复的辅助手段提供了新的方向，但仍需更大规模的研究来验证其临床意义。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部练习对慢性卒中患者皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究（N=7 慢性卒中患者）发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部练习使慢性卒中患者的指深屈肌（FDS）运动诱发电位（MEP）振幅增加了约 22.3%，尽管未达统计学显著性，但提示其具有增强皮质脊髓兴奋性的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: HD-tACS combined with robot-assisted hand exercises shows promise in enhancing corticospinal excitability in stroke patients. This offers a new direction for adjunctive stroke rehabilitation, but larger studies are needed to confirm its clinical significance.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步研究，样本量小（7 名慢性卒中患者），且未达到统计学显著性，需要更大规模研究的证实。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary study with a small sample size (7 chronic stroke individuals), and the change was not statistically significant, requiring confirmation by larger studies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Factors associated with 1-year health-related quality of life after neck-specific exercise in chronic whiplash-associated disorders: an exploratory secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT (N=140) in chronic whiplash-associated disorders found that improvements in psychosocial measures, pain, and disability were associated with improvements in HRQoL at 3 and 15 months after neck-specific exercise, with higher baseline psychosocial distress and disability also associated with clinically relevant HRQoL improvement at 15 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项对慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者的研究提示，除颈部特异性运动外，社会心理因素和功能障碍程度也可能影响一年后的健康相关生活质量。在治疗中，你应同时关注患者的心理健康和功能表现。
items.titleZh: 慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者颈部特异性运动后 1 年健康相关生活质量的相关因素：一项随机对照试验的探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性挥鞭伤相关疾病患者的 RCT 二次分析（N=140）发现，社会心理测量、疼痛和残疾的改善与颈部特异性运动后 3 个月和 15 个月健康相关生活质量的改善相关，基线社会心理困扰和残疾程度较高也与 15 个月时健康相关生活质量的临床显著改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on patients with chronic whiplash-associated disorders suggests that psychosocial factors and the degree of disability, in addition to neck-specific exercises, may influence health-related quality of life after one year. In your treatment, you should concurrently address patients' mental health and functional performance.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性二次分析，模型的预测能力较弱（R² = 0.20-0.27, Q² = 0.06-0.13），结果应被视为假设生成。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory secondary analysis with weak predictive ability of the models (R² = 0.20-0.27, Q² = 0.06-0.13), and the findings should be considered hypothesis-generating.

items.title: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of football players undergoing primary ACL-R (mean follow-up 5.2 years) found no association between autograft type (hamstring, patellar, or quadriceps tendon) and revision ACLR risk. However, quadriceps tendon was associated with a higher hazard of contralateral ACLR in women (HR 1.98, 95% CI 1.17 to 3.36).
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究显示，足球运动员 ACL 重建术后的移植物类型与翻修手术风险无关，但年轻和高水平运动员后续受伤风险更高。这提示你，在与足球运动员讨论 ACL 康复和风险管理时，重点应放在年龄和运动水平，而非移植物选择上。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员前交叉韧带翻修重建无关：一项全国性队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后的全国性队列研究（平均随访 5.2 年）发现，自体移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱）与翻修 ACL 重建风险无关。然而，女性中股四头肌腱与对侧 ACL 重建的较高风险相关（HR 1.98，95% CI 1.17 至 3.36）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction risk in football players, but younger age and higher pre-injury activity levels are consistently linked to greater subsequent injury risk. This suggests that when discussing ACL rehabilitation and risk management with football players, your focus should be on age and activity level, rather than graft choice.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是翻修 ACL 重建和对侧 ACL 重建，未评估移植物类型与功能恢复或重返运动表现等其他临床结局的关系。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on revision ACL reconstruction and contralateral ACL reconstruction, and did not evaluate the relationship between graft type and other clinical outcomes such as functional recovery or return-to-sport performance.

items.title: Optimising Pre-race Physical Preparation for Sprint Events at Major Championships Under New Rule Changes and Competition Formats
items.summary: This leading article reviews optimal pre-race physical preparation for sprint events under new rule changes, recommending strategies like same-day priming sessions, passive insulation for muscle temperature maintenance, and brief plyometric or acceleration stimuli 8–16 minutes before race start, while acknowledging limited direct evidence in elite sprinters.
items.curatedReason: 这份述评虽然是专家共识而非实证，但仍对短跑运动员的赛前准备提出了实用的建议。在新的比赛规则下，你可以尝试维持肌肉温度的被动热绝缘，以及赛前 8-16 分钟的短时增强式或加速刺激，但请记住，这在精英短跑运动员中尚缺乏直接证据。
items.titleZh: 新规则和竞赛形式下大型锦标赛短跑项目赛前身体准备的优化
items.summaryZh: 这篇前瞻性文章回顾了新规则下短跑项目赛前身体准备的优化策略，建议采取诸如当日预启动训练、被动保温以维持肌肉温度以及赛前 8-16 分钟的简短增强式或加速刺激等策略，但承认在精英短跑运动员中直接证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: While an expert consensus rather than empirical evidence, this leading article offers practical recommendations for sprinters' pre-race preparation. Under new competition rules, consider passive insulation for muscle temperature and brief plyometric or acceleration stimuli 8–16 minutes before the start, but be aware that direct evidence in elite sprinters is limited.
items.limitation: 本文为综述性述评，基于现有证据和机制理论提出建议，但缺乏直接在精英短跑运动员中模拟大赛情境的实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a leading article based on existing evidence and mechanistic rationale, but lacks direct empirical research simulating major championship demands in elite sprinters.

items.title: Recovery strategies, training volume, and performance in Japanese recreational marathon runners: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 5,204 Japanese recreational marathon runners found that bathing, stretching, hot spring use, and massage were the most common recovery strategies, while specialized modalities were less used. Active recovery, contrast baths, and acupuncture/moxibustion showed modest associations with shorter personal best marathon times and higher monthly training volume.
items.curatedReason: 这项对日本休闲马拉松跑者的调查显示，洗浴、拉伸和按摩是常用的恢复策略，而专业服务的使用率较低。你可以根据这些发现，为你的跑者患者提供更符合其习惯且经济高效的恢复建议。
items.titleZh: 日本休闲马拉松跑者的恢复策略、训练量和表现：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 5,204 名日本休闲马拉松跑者的横断面调查发现，洗浴、拉伸、温泉和按摩是最常用的恢复策略，而专业康复手段使用较少。主动恢复、冷热交替浴以及针灸/艾灸与较短的马拉松个人最好成绩和较高的月训练量有适度关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of Japanese recreational marathon runners indicates that bathing, stretching, and massage are commonly used recovery strategies, with lower utilization of specialized services. You can use these findings to offer more habitual and cost-effective recovery advice to your running patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅能发现恢复策略与训练量和表现之间的关联性，不能确立因果关系；且回复率较低，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional survey, which can only identify associations between recovery strategies, training volume, and performance, but cannot establish causality; the low response rate also suggests potential selection bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A Foundational Balance Training Exercise Program for People with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: This review discusses the foundational balance training needs for individuals with blindness or low vision, emphasizing the increased reliance on somatosensory and vestibular systems due to reduced visual input.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述强调了视觉障碍患者平衡训练的重要性，并指出了目前对这类人群平衡训练项目的不足。它提示你在设计视障患者康复方案时，应特别关注体感和前庭系统的代偿性训练，以提升他们的安全移动能力。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练方案
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了盲人或低视力人群的基础平衡训练需求，强调由于视觉输入减少，他们对体感和前庭系统的依赖性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights the importance of balance training for individuals with visual impairments and the current inadequacy of such programs. It suggests that when designing rehabilitation plans for visually impaired patients, you should specifically focus on compensatory training of the somatosensory and vestibular systems to improve their safe mobility.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Modality-specific, deficit-targeted exercise prescriptions for physical function in sarcopenia and frailty: a network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 61 RCTs (3,706 participants) on sarcopenia and frailty found that multicomponent training with resistance training offered the most comprehensive benefits for functional mobility (low certainty). Elastic band resistance training was most effective for handgrip strength (MD 1.95 kg; 95% CI, 1.13 to 2.76; moderate certainty), and machine-based resistance training showed intermediate effectiveness for knee extension strength (MD 2.96 kg; 95% CI, 1.59 to 4.34; low certainty).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持对肌少症和衰弱老年人采用“特定模式、靶向缺陷”的运动处方。你可以优先考虑多组分训练，特别是包含阻力训练的方案来改善功能性活动能力，并利用弹力带和器械阻力训练来针对性地提升握力和膝关节伸展力量。
items.titleZh: 针对肌少症和衰弱体能的特定模式、靶向缺陷运动处方：一项网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 61 项随机对照试验（3,706 名参与者）的肌少症和衰弱网络荟萃分析发现，包含阻力训练的多组分训练对功能性活动能力提供了最全面的益处（证据确定性低）。弹力带阻力训练对握力最有效（MD 1.95 公斤；95% CI，1.13 至 2.76；证据确定性中等），而器械阻力训练对膝关节伸展力量显示出中等有效性（MD 2.96 公斤；95% CI，1.59 至 4.34；证据确定性低）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports a “modality-specific, deficit-targeted” exercise prescription for older adults with sarcopenia and frailty. You can prioritize multi-component training, especially resistance training, to improve functional mobility, and use elastic band and machine-based resistance training to specifically enhance handgrip and knee extension strength.
items.limitation: 本网络荟萃分析中，多组分训练对功能性活动能力的证据确定性较低，且一些阻力训练的证据确定性也为低或中等，可能影响结论的强度。
items.limitationEn: In this network meta-analysis, the certainty of evidence for multicomponent training on functional mobility was low, and for some resistance training, it was also low or moderate, which may affect the strength of the conclusions.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Accreditation Committee published its "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation" on October 16, 2026. These principles aim to guide accreditation authorities in adopting outcome-based approaches to health practitioner education, fostering flexibility and innovation, and supporting education delivery in underserved locations to address workforce challenges in Australia.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 发布了“基于结果的认证方法原则”，这标志着澳大利亚医疗专业教育认证的重大转变。这些原则旨在促进灵活和创新的教育模式，尤其支持在农村和偏远地区提供教育，这将直接影响 PT 教育和劳动力供应，对执业范围和远程医疗政策也可能产生间接影响。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构——基于结果的认证方法使用原则
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 认证委员会于 2026 年 10 月 16 日发布了“基于结果的认证方法使用原则”。这些原则旨在指导认证机构在健康从业者教育中采用基于结果的方法，促进灵活性和创新，并支持在澳大利亚医疗服务不足地区提供教育，以解决劳动力挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has published "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation," marking a significant shift in health professional education accreditation in Australia. These principles aim to promote flexible and innovative educational models, particularly supporting education delivery in rural and remote areas, which will directly impact PT education and workforce supply, with potential indirect effects on scope of practice and telehealth policies.

items.title: Geriatric interdisciplinary intermediate care after hip fracture: associations with immobility and recurrent falls
items.summary: A retrospective observational cohort study of 205 hip fracture patients found that those receiving Geriatric Interdisciplinary Intermediate Care (GIMC) had lower observed immobility (17.0% vs. 32.7%) and fewer recurrent falls (1.1% vs. 5.2%) at one-year follow-up compared to usual care. GIMC patients were also more likely to be ambulatory (82.0% vs. 67.3%).
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，老年综合跨学科中间护理（GIMC）可能与髋部骨折老年患者的较低不动性和较少复发性跌倒相关。这强调了多学科协作和家庭康复在老年患者术后管理中的价值，鼓励你在实践中积极推动和参与此类综合护理模式。
items.titleZh: 髋部骨折后老年综合跨学科中间护理：与不动性和复发性跌倒的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 205 名髋部骨折患者的回顾性观察队列研究发现，与常规护理相比，接受老年综合跨学科中间护理（GIMC）的患者在一年随访时观察到的不动性较低（17.0% vs. 32.7%），复发性跌倒也较少（1.1% vs. 5.2%）。GIMC 患者也更有可能恢复行走能力（82.0% vs. 67.3%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that Geriatric Interdisciplinary Intermediate Care (GIMC) may be associated with lower immobility and fewer recurrent falls in older adults after hip fracture. This highlights the value of multidisciplinary collaboration and home-based rehabilitation in post-operative management of elderly patients, encouraging you to actively promote and participate in such integrated care models.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察队列研究，可能存在混杂因素和选择偏倚，导致无法建立明确的因果关系，且结果的普遍性可能受限于单中心数据。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational cohort study may be subject to confounding factors and selection bias, preventing the establishment of clear causal relationships, and the generalizability of results may be limited by single-center data.

items.title: Effects of resistance training intensity and a dietary protein intervention on psychosocial outcomes, executive function, and quality of life in frail community-dwelling older adults
items.summary: A secondary analysis of the TEAMS RCT (n=295 frail older adults) found that 12 weeks of supervised resistance training to volitional muscular failure reduced depressive symptoms (β = −0.167), improved executive function (TMT-A β = −4.71 s; TMT-B β = −12.11 s; SCWT log β = −0.091; LF β = +2.46 words), and enhanced quality of life (β = +1.26). Training intensity did not consistently influence these changes. A dietary protein intervention led to a greater reduction in fear of falling (log β = −0.257) but no consistent additional benefits for other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对衰弱社区老年人进行 12 周监督阻力训练，可改善抑郁症状、执行功能和生活质量，且训练强度似乎不是主要影响因素。虽然蛋白质干预对跌倒恐惧有额外益处，但整体效果不一致。这意味着你在为这类患者制定康复计划时，应优先考虑坚持阻力训练本身，并可考虑将蛋白质补充作为辅助。
items.titleZh: 阻力训练强度和膳食蛋白质干预对衰弱社区老年人心理社会结局、执行功能和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 随机对照试验（n=295 名衰弱老年人）的二次分析发现，12 周监督下的力竭阻力训练可减轻抑郁症状（β = −0.167），改善执行功能（TMT-A β = −4.71 秒；TMT-B β = −12.11 秒；SCWT log β = −0.091；LF β = +2.46 词），并提高生活质量（β = +1.26）。训练强度并未持续影响这些变化。膳食蛋白质干预导致跌倒恐惧症更大幅度下降（log β = −0.257），但对其他结局没有持续的额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that 12 weeks of supervised resistance training for frail community-dwelling older adults can improve depressive symptoms, executive function, and quality of life, with training intensity not appearing to be a major influencing factor. While protein intervention showed additional benefits for fear of falling, the overall effect was inconsistent. This means when designing rehabilitation plans for such patients, you should prioritize adherence to resistance training itself, and consider protein supplementation as an adjunct.
items.limitation: 本研究是随机对照试验的二次分析，并非主要结局，且训练强度和蛋白质干预的额外益处并不一致，需要前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis of an RCT, not the primary outcome, and the additional benefits of training intensity and protein intervention were inconsistent, requiring prospective validation.

items.title: Effect of lumbar strengthening exercises on kinesiophobia in people with chronic low back pain: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 3 RCTs found inconsistent evidence regarding the effectiveness of lumbar strengthening exercises in reducing kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic low back pain. While one trial reported significant reductions with isokinetic trunk strengthening compared to core stabilization and conventional exercise, two found no significant differences. The overall certainty of evidence was graded as very low.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调，目前关于腰部强化训练能否有效降低慢性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症的证据非常有限且质量较低。在常规临床实践中，你不应过度依赖单一的腰部强化训练来解决运动恐惧症，而应结合多模式干预。
items.titleZh: 腰部强化训练对慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧症的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，关于腰部强化训练能否有效减少慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧症的证据不一致。尽管一项试验报告等速躯干强化训练相较于核心稳定和常规运动能显著降低运动恐惧症，但另两项试验未发现显著差异。总体证据确定性被评定为非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that current evidence on whether lumbar strengthening exercises effectively reduce kinesiophobia in chronic low back pain patients is very limited and of low quality. In routine clinical practice, you should not over-rely on solitary lumbar strengthening to address kinesiophobia, but rather integrate multimodal interventions.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入了 3 项研究，证据确定性非常低，且研究间干预措施和对照组差异较大，限制了结论的通用性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 3 studies, with very low certainty of evidence and considerable heterogeneity in interventions and control groups, limiting the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: Intermittent theta burst stimulation on the cerebellar Hemisphere to imprOve Post-stroke cognitivE impairment (HOPE): a multicentre randomised controlled double-blind trial
items.summary: The HOPE trial is a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled study designed to investigate the safety and efficacy of intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) on the contralesional cerebellar hemisphere to improve cognitive function in 70 adults with cognitive impairment within 14 days after a first-ever unilateral supratentorial ischaemic stroke. Participants will receive 7 consecutive days of stimulation and be followed for 180 days, with the primary efficacy outcome being Montreal Cognitive Assessment score change at day 90±7.
items.curatedReason: HOPE 试验旨在探索小脑间歇性 θ 爆发刺激（iTBS）对早期卒中后认知障碍（PSCI）的安全性与疗效。如果结果积极，它可能为卒中康复提供一种新的认知神经调控策略，但目前仍是协议阶段，期待最终结果。
items.titleZh: 小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激改善卒中后认知障碍（HOPE）的安全性与疗效：一项多中心随机对照双盲试验
items.summaryZh: HOPE 试验是一项多中心、随机、双盲、假对照研究，旨在评估对侧小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激（iTBS）对 70 名首次单侧幕上缺血性卒中后 14 天内出现认知障碍成人认知功能的安全性与有效性。参与者将接受连续 7 天的刺激，并随访 180 天，主要疗效指标为第 90±7 天蒙特利尔认知评估评分的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The HOPE trial aims to explore the safety and efficacy of cerebellar intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) for early post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI). If positive, it could offer a new cognitive neuromodulation strategy for stroke rehabilitation, but it is currently in the protocol stage, awaiting final results.
items.limitation: 本研究目前仅是试验方案，尚未产出临床数据，因此无法评估其有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study is currently only a trial protocol, with no clinical data yet, so its effectiveness and safety cannot be evaluated.

items.title: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise (VT+TE) significantly improved TUG performance, self-selected gait speed, disability, and flexion/extension repositioning errors more than treadmill exercise alone (TE) or core stabilization in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain. Both VT+TE and TE improved pain and depressive symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 有慢性腰痛患者？在跑步机训练中加入垂直牵引和部分体重支持，能更好地改善步态、减轻残疾、并提升躯干本体感觉。考虑作为现有方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 带垂直牵引与不带垂直牵引的跑步机运动对慢性机械性腰痛患者步态、疼痛、残疾、躯干本体感觉和抑郁的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）显示，在跑步机运动中加入垂直牵引和部分体重支持（VT+TE），与单纯跑步机运动（TE）或核心稳定训练相比，能更好地改善慢性机械性腰痛患者的起立行走时间（TUG）、自选步速、残疾和屈伸体位再现错误。两种跑步机方案均能改善疼痛和抑郁症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic low back pain, adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise can further improve gait, reduce disability, and enhance trunk proprioception. Consider this as an adjunct to existing interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（n=45），且未能区分垂直卸载和悬吊支持的单独效应。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=45) and could not differentiate the individual effects of vertical unloading versus harness support.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and facilitators influencing Austrian physiotherapists' adherence to CPGs and return to sport criteria after ACLR. Key barriers included limited CPG usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, resource limitations, and interprofessional misalignment, while facilitators included structured guidelines, professional development, and institutional support.
items.curatedReason: 临床实践指南（CPG）在 ACLR 康复中的依从性仍不理想。本研究揭示了依从性的障碍（指南可用性、患者期望、专业态度、跨专业协作差）与促进因素，你可以借此审视自身实践，寻找改进点。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项奥地利的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响奥地利物理治疗师依从前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）后临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素。主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、专业态度、资源限制和跨专业协作不良，而促进因素则包括结构化指南、专业发展和机构支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) in ACLR rehabilitation remains suboptimal. This study reveals barriers (guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, poor interprofessional collaboration) and facilitators of adherence, offering insights to review your own practice for improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（9 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 physiotherapists), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: This commentary describes a clinical framework for implementing and interpreting quality of movement assessment tools during rehabilitation and return-to-sport decision-making for pediatric and adolescent patients following ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 在青少年 ACLR 术后康复中，你应该考虑将运动质量评估纳入重返运动决策。这能让你更全面地评估患者 readiness，潜在降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年 ACL 重建术后运动质量评估：指导康复和重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 本评论描述了一个临床框架，用于在前交叉韧带重建术后的青少年患者康复和重返运动决策中，实施和解读运动质量评估工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: In pediatric and adolescent ACLR rehab, you should consider incorporating quality of movement assessments into return-to-sport decisions. This provides a more holistic readiness assessment and may reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，不涉及原始数据或系统性证据，其建议的强度低于实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a clinical commentary, not based on original data or systematic evidence, so its recommendations have a lower level of evidence than empirical studies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report of a world-class female wrestler after pectoralis major repair showed that force plate-based assessment of maximal (NPF) and rapid (NF200) isometric shoulder strength, particularly NF200, lagged behind NPF recovery and was angle-dependent.
items.curatedReason: 力板评估可实时监测胸大肌修复术后世界级摔跤运动员的肩部力量恢复，尤其快速发力能力恢复滞后于最大力量，且存在角度依赖性。这对你的重返运动评估是个提醒：关注多维度和快速力量指标。
items.titleZh: 世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后重返运动过程中最大和快速等长肩部力量的力板评估：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后的病例报告显示，基于力板的最大（NPF）和快速（NF200）等长肩部力量评估中，NF200 的恢复滞后于 NPF，并具有角度依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Force plate assessment can monitor shoulder strength recovery in a world-class wrestler after pectoralis major repair, revealing that rapid force production lags behind maximal strength and is angle-dependent. This is a reminder for your return-to-sport evaluations: focus on multidirectional and rapid force metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的普适性极低，仅能提供初步的临床观察和方法学参考。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very low, offering only preliminary clinical observations and methodological references.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: This commentary proposes an integrative model for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the protective roles of feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact. It clarifies why pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric-strength training are crucial for injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论指出，预防非接触性 ACL 损伤的关键在于强化落地前的襠绳肌预张力及肌联蛋白刚度。这意味着你的预防和康复训练应更侧重于落地策略的优化和离心力量训练。
items.titleZh: 非接触性 ACL 损伤的感觉运动和分子机制：一种整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 本评论提出了一种非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合模型，强调了触地前前馈脕绳肌张力和肌联蛋白僵硬在保护中的作用。它阐明了为什么触地前落地策略和离心力量训练对损伤预防至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact are crucial for non-contact ACL injury prevention. Your prevention and rehabilitation strategies should therefore emphasize optimizing pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为理论模型和临床述评，不包含实验数据验证，其提出的假说需未来实证研究支持。
items.limitationEn: This study is a theoretical model and clinical commentary, lacking experimental data validation, and its proposed hypothesis requires future empirical support.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: The effect of functional inspiratory muscle training on diaphragm function and core stabilisation in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A 10-week multicomponent functional inspiratory muscle training (F-IMT) program significantly improved diaphragm thickness (adjusted difference, 2.434 mm; 95% CI, 1.714 to 3.261; P < .001) and mobility, pain, respiratory muscle strength, and core stabilization in 40 CNSLBP patients compared to thoracic expansion exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 明确指出功能性吸气肌训练 (F-IMT) 在改善慢性非特异性腰痛 (CNSLBP) 患者的膈肌功能和核心稳定性方面优于胸廓扩张训练。在临床实践中，你应考虑将 F-IMT 纳入 CNSLBP 患者的康复方案，尤其关注其对膈肌厚度和疼痛的显著改善。
items.titleZh: 功能性吸气肌训练对慢性非特异性腰痛患者膈肌功能和核心稳定性的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 10 周的多成分功能性吸气肌训练 (F-IMT) 项目，在 40 名慢性非特异性腰痛患者中，与胸廓扩张训练相比，显著改善了膈肌厚度（调整后差异 2.434 毫米；95% CI，1.714 至 3.261；P < .001）、活动度、疼痛、呼吸肌力量和核心稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that Functional Inspiratory Muscle Training (F-IMT) is superior to thoracic expansion exercises for improving diaphragm function and core stabilization in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain (CNSLBP). In clinical practice, you should consider incorporating F-IMT into CNSLBP rehabilitation programs, especially noting its significant improvements in diaphragm thickness and pain.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，可能会限制结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Restoring Physical Resilience: Consistent Functional and Sarcopenia Gains Across Two Vivifrail Cohorts
items.summary: A 36-week community multicomponent exercise program (Vivifrail model) improved SPPB scores by a mean of 1.33 points (Cohen's d = 0.96; p < .001) and reduced probable sarcopenia from 17.4% to 5.4% (p = .006) across two cohorts of 178 older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对 Vivifrail 模型的观察研究提示，为期 36 周的社区多成分运动计划能显著改善老年人身体功能（SPPB 评分平均提高 1.33 分）并降低肌少症患病率（从 17.4% 降至 5.4%）。在老年康复中，你应考虑推广此类长期、综合性社区运动干预以促进衰弱管理和跌倒预防。
items.titleZh: 恢复身体韧性：两项 Vivifrail 队列中功能和肌少症的持续改善
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 36 周的社区多成分运动项目（Vivifrail 模型）在两项共 178 名老年人的队列研究中，使 SPPB 评分平均提高了 1.33 分（Cohen's d = 0.96；p < .001），并将可能患肌少症的比例从 17.4% 降至 5.4%（p = .006）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study on the Vivifrail model suggests that a 36-week community multicomponent exercise program significantly improves physical function in older adults (average 1.33 point increase in SPPB scores) and reduces probable sarcopenia prevalence (from 17.4% to 5.4%). In geriatric rehabilitation, you should consider promoting such long-term, comprehensive community exercise interventions to support frailty management and fall prevention.
items.limitation: 本研究采用准实验单臂设计，不能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study used a quasi-experimental, single-arm design, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from LMICs found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications were associated with reductions in fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults.
items.curatedReason: 在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），多因素干预、运动和家庭安全改造可降低老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧。您在这些地区开展跌倒预防工作时，应将高收入国家经验进行本地化适应。
items.titleZh: 低收入和中等收入国家老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项综合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 14 项来自低收入和中等收入国家研究的综合性综述发现，多因素干预、运动方案和家庭安全改造与老年人跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧的降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), multifactorial interventions, exercise, and home safety modifications can reduce fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults. When implementing fall prevention in these regions, you should adapt high-income country experiences to local contexts.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究数量有限（14 项），且干预措施和测量结局存在异质性，因此结论的普遍性和确定性受限。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (14) and heterogeneity in interventions and outcomes restrict the generalizability and certainty of the conclusions.

items.title: Development of a Communication Characteristics Module for Autistic Adults and the Creation of a Communication Profile Variable
items.summary: Researchers developed and validated a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults using a community-based participatory research approach. The module demonstrated high feasibility and strong construct validity, providing a valid tool for characterizing communication diversity in research, clinical, and service settings.
items.curatedReason: 我们现在有了一个经验证的10项沟通特征模块和五级沟通概况变量，用于评估自闭症成年人的沟通多样性。这有助于我们更精准地理解和描述自闭症成年人在不同情境下的沟通方式，而非仅仅停留在诊断层面。
items.titleZh: 自闭症成年人沟通特征模块的开发及沟通概况变量的创建
items.summaryZh: 研究人员采用社区参与式研究方法，开发并验证了一个包含 10 个项目的自闭症成年人沟通特征模块和一个五级沟通概况变量。该模块在可行性和结构效度方面表现出色，为研究、临床和服务环境中表征沟通多样性提供了有效工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: We now have a validated 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for assessing communication diversity in autistic adults. This tool will help us more precisely understand and describe the communication styles of autistic adults across various settings, moving beyond a sole diagnostic focus.
items.limitation: 本研究基于自闭症成年人的自我报告数据，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on self-reported data from autistic adults, which may introduce reporting bias.

items.title: A multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy improves neuromuscular restoration and attenuates inflammatory and oxidative stress responses following a standardized football match: a randomized crossover study
items.summary: A randomized crossover study (n=20 male semi-professional football players) found that a modern multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, percussive therapy) significantly improved neuromuscular restoration and attenuated inflammatory/oxidative stress markers post-match compared to passive recovery, with outcome-specific differences from traditional active recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（如极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压和冲击疗法）比传统主动跑步或被动恢复更能支持短期神经肌肉恢复，并减轻足球比赛后的生化紊乱。您可以考虑将其整合到运动队的赛后恢复方案中。
items.titleZh: 多模式非疲劳性恢复策略在标准化足球比赛后改善神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症和氧化应激反应：一项随机交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉研究（20 名半专业男足球运动员）发现，现代多模式非疲劳性恢复策略（极低强度骑行、泡沫滚压、冲击疗法）与被动恢复相比，能显著改善赛后神经肌肉恢复并减轻炎症/氧化应激标志物，与传统主动恢复的差异则取决于具体结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that a multimodal non-fatiguing recovery strategy (e.g., very low-intensity cycling, foam rolling, and percussive therapy) may better support short-term neuromuscular recovery and attenuate biochemical disturbances after a football match compared to traditional active running or passive recovery. Consider integrating this into your sports teams' post-match recovery protocols.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=20），且未前瞻性注册临床试验，部分结果在多模式与传统主动恢复间未显示持续性优势，需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=20), was not prospectively registered, and some results did not consistently show an advantage of multimodal over traditional active recovery, requiring cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title:
Effectiveness of physical, psychological, and alternative interventions for post-COVID-19 condition: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 27 RCTs (1998 participants) found that supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise consistently improved cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 condition, while cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced fatigue. However, most trials had a high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动对改善新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力有显著益处，认知行为疗法（CBT）也能有效减轻疲劳和注意力问题。您可以将这些干预措施纳入临床实践，但请注意许多研究的偏倚风险较高。
items.titleZh: 物理、心理和替代干预措施对新冠后遗症的有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项随机对照试验（1998 名参与者）的系统综述发现，监督下的心肺康复和多模式运动持续改善了新冠后遗症患者的心肺适应能力和步行能力，而认知行为疗法则减轻了疲劳。然而，大多数试验存在高偏倚风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found significant benefits of supervised cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and multimodal exercise for improving cardiorespiratory fitness and walking capacity in post-COVID-19 patients, with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) also effective in reducing fatigue and concentration issues. You can incorporate these interventions into clinical practice, but be aware of the high risk of bias in many studies.
items.limitation: 多数纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，样本量小且随访期短，且因异质性未能进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies had a high risk of bias, small sample sizes, and short follow-up periods, and meta-analysis was not performed due to heterogeneity.

items.title: What’s Behind the Label? Rethinking Exercise Prescription for Tendinopathy - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: This BJSM blog post argues that exercise prescription for tendinopathy should move beyond generic labels (e.g., eccentric, isometric) to detailed documentation of the "mechanical dose," including actual load, effort, repetitions, tempo, range, and patient response, to improve clinical reasoning and reporting.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调，肌腱病变康复中，不应仅仅记录“离心、等长、慢速大负荷”等笼统的运动名称，而应详细记录实际负荷、次数、速度、范围和患者反应等具体“机械剂量”。这有助于您更精准地评估干预效果并调整方案。
items.titleZh: 标签背后是什么？重新思考肌腱病变的运动处方
items.summaryZh: 这篇 BJSM 博客文章认为，肌腱病变的运动处方应超越笼统的标签（如离心、等长），转向详细记录“机械剂量”，包括实际负荷、努力程度、重复次数、节奏、范围和患者反应，以改进临床推理和报告。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary emphasizes that in tendinopathy rehabilitation, you should not just record general exercise names like "eccentric, isometric, or heavy slow resistance," but rather detailed "mechanical doses" such as actual load, repetitions, speed, range, and patient response. This will help you more accurately evaluate intervention effectiveness and adjust treatment plans.

items.title: Physical Therapy in the News: September 2026
items.summary: APTA's "Physical Therapy in the News: September 2026" is a monthly series highlighting recent media coverage of the physical therapy profession and APTA members.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了其“物理治疗新闻”月度摘要。您可以阅读以快速了解上个月美国物理治疗行业的媒体关注点和重要动态。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 9 月物理治疗新闻 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 的“物理治疗新闻”是一个月度系列，重点报道物理治疗行业和 APTA 会员的最新媒体动态。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released its monthly "Physical Therapy in the News" summary for September 2026. You can read it to quickly catch up on last month's media coverage and key developments in the US physical therapy profession.

items.title: Development and validation of a prediction model for subsequent fractures after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study developed and validated a nomogram to predict subsequent fractures within 2 years after hip fracture surgery in older adults, showing good discriminative performance (C-index 0.891 in development cohort) with age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone as predictors, and exercise as a protective factor.
items.curatedReason: 对于髋部骨折术后的老年患者，这个回顾性队列研究提示我们可以通过年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾和独居等因素，加上运动史，初步判断两年内再骨折的风险。不过，这只是个回顾性观察研究，在临床上真正使用这个列线图前，需要更强的RCT证据验证其前瞻性预测效力。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后再次骨折预测模型的开发与验证：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究开发并验证了一个用于预测老年髋部骨折术后两年内再次骨折的列线图。该模型表现出良好的区分度（开发队列 C-index 0.891），识别出年龄、髋关节功能、神经退行性疾病、眼疾、独居为预测因素，运动为保护因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults post-hip fracture surgery, this retrospective cohort study suggests we can use factors like age, hip function, neurodegenerative disease, eye disease, and living alone, alongside exercise history, to estimate the risk of re-fracture within two years. However, this is a retrospective observational study; stronger RCT evidence is needed to prospectively validate its predictive power before clinical implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了时间验证，但仍需要前瞻性研究来进一步确认模型的预测性能和临床实用性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study; despite temporal validation, prospective studies are needed to further confirm the model's predictive performance and clinical utility.

items.title: Effects of extracorporeal shockwave therapy on pain intensity and functional disability in chronic low back pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 9 RCTs (N=430) found that radial extracorporeal shockwave therapy (rESWT) significantly reduced pain in chronic low back pain (SMD = -0.72; 95% CI -1.30 to -0.14), but functional improvements (MD = -6.12) did not meet the minimal clinically important difference.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性腰痛，体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）特别是径向冲击波（rESWT）在短期疼痛管理上显示出中等效应量（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善的临床意义不明显。别将其作为独立疗法，而应作为运动疗法的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 体外冲击波疗法对慢性腰痛疼痛强度和功能障碍的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含9项RCT（N=430）的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）可显著减轻慢性腰痛患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.72），但功能改善（MD = -6.12）未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), especially radial ESWT (rESWT), shows a moderate effect size (SMD = -0.72) for short-term pain reduction, but functional improvements are not clinically meaningful. Do not consider it a standalone treatment; use it as an adjunct to exercise therapy.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的证据多为干预后即时评估，随访期短，且各研究间存在显著异质性。
items.limitationEn: Evidence in this systematic review is largely based on immediate post-intervention assessments with short follow-up, and there is significant heterogeneity among studies.

items.title: Physical activity guidelines' impact on cognition in multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 RCTs (N=462) found that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) significantly improved processing speed (SMD = 0.29), visuospatial memory (SMD = 0.47), and verbal memory (SMD = 0.75).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可以显著改善处理速度和记忆力。在管理MS患者时，将达标的运动处方纳入认知康复计划，这应成为你的首选干预方案。
items.titleZh: 身体活动指南对多发性硬化症患者认知功能的影响：随机临床试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含12项RCT（N=462）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，达到多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动指南要求，可显著改善处理速度（SMD = 0.29）、视觉空间记忆（SMD = 0.47）和言语记忆（SMD = 0.75）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clearly indicates that meeting physical activity guidelines for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) can significantly improve processing speed and memory. When managing MS patients, incorporating guideline-compliant exercise prescriptions into cognitive rehabilitation programs should be your preferred intervention.
items.limitation: 本系统综述纳入的随机对照试验数量有限，且存在较高偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included a limited number of randomized controlled trials with a high risk of bias.

items.title: Feasibility of Distributed Wearable Ultrasound for Detecting Neuromuscular Coordination Differences After Knee Injury
items.summary: A feasibility study with 20 NCAA Division I women athletes (8 with prior knee injury) using a four-channel distributed wearable ultrasound (D-WUS) system found that D-WUS detected significant differences in right-limb neuromuscular coordination (VL-VMO correlation p=0.029; timing symmetry p=0.019) in those with previous knee injuries, differences not reflected in force-plate biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 可穿戴超声系统在检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调性差异方面表现出可行性，且能发现传统力板生物力学未反映出的问题。在评估和监测膝关节康复进展时，未来可以考虑将其作为客观量化肌肉收缩模式的补充工具，但目前尚需大规模研究验证其临床实用性。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴分布式超声检测膝关节损伤后神经肌肉协调差异的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对20名NCAA一级大学女子运动员（8名有既往膝关节损伤）的可行性研究，使用四通道分布式可穿戴超声（D-WUS）系统，发现在有既往膝关节损伤的运动员中，D-WUS能检测到右肢神经肌肉协调性的显著差异（VL-VMO相关性 p=0.029；时间对称性 p=0.019），这些差异未在力板生物力学中体现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Wearable ultrasound systems show feasibility in detecting neuromuscular coordination differences after knee injury, revealing issues not reflected by traditional force plate biomechanics. In assessing and monitoring knee rehabilitation progress, consider it a supplementary tool for objective quantification of muscle contraction patterns, though large-scale studies are needed to validate its clinical utility.
items.limitation: 本研究是初步的可行性研究，样本量小（N=20），且仅限于大学女子运动员这一特定人群。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary feasibility study with a small sample size (N=20) and is limited to a specific population of NCAA Division I women athletes.

items.title: Significant others' perspectives on formal supports at 3- and 12-months post-discharge from specialist rehabilitation units following acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring perspectives of 24 significant others at 3 months and 19 at 12 months post-discharge from inpatient rehabilitation found that family members play a central role in filling gaps in formal support systems for individuals with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury, highlighting communication and support understanding as key barriers.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后，家庭成员在正式支持服务中面临的挑战。作为临床医生，你必须主动且清晰地向家属提供支持资源信息，并更早地将他们纳入康复决策过程，以减轻家属的负担并提高患者依从性。
items.titleZh: 脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月主要照护者对正式支持的看法
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究调查了24名和19名主要照护者在脑损伤和脊髓损伤患者出院后3个月和12个月的看法，发现家庭成员在弥补正式支持系统不足方面发挥核心作用，并强调沟通和对支持的理解是主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the challenges faced by family members in accessing formal support services after discharge for patients with acquired brain injury and spinal cord injury. As a clinician, you must proactively and clearly provide families with information about support resources and involve them earlier in the rehabilitation decision-making process to alleviate caregiver burden and improve patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性方法，样本量相对较小，结果主要反映了特定地区（澳大利亚昆士兰州）家属的视角。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a relatively small sample size, and its findings primarily reflect the perspectives of family members in a specific region (Queensland, Australia).

items.title: Process evaluation of daily electrical stimulation to prevent recurring pressure ulcers in individuals with spinal cord injury: the SCI PREVOLT trial.
items.summary: A mixed-methods process evaluation with 70 participants and 13 healthcare professionals assessed the implementation of electrical stimulation (ES) for pressure ulcer prevention in individuals with spinal cord injury, identifying limited evidence, usability issues, and organizational barriers (e.g., lack of reimbursement) that hinder adoption and adherence in home and rehabilitation settings.
items.curatedReason: 这项过程评估揭示了在家用和康复环境中实施电刺激预防脊髓损伤压疮的障碍，包括证据有限、可用性差和组织问题。在你考虑推广或应用类似技术时，务必关注这些实际障碍，确保有明确的指导和支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者日常电刺激预防压疮复发的过程评估：SCI PREVOLT 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项包含70名参与者和13名医疗专业人员的混合方法过程评估，旨在评估电刺激（ES）预防脊髓损伤压疮的实施情况，发现证据有限、可用性问题和组织障碍（如缺乏报销）是阻碍在家用和康复环境中采用和依从性的主要因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This process evaluation reveals barriers to implementing electrical stimulation for pressure ulcer prevention in spinal cord injury patients at home and in rehabilitation settings, including limited evidence, poor usability, and organizational issues. When considering the adoption or promotion of similar technologies, you must address these practical barriers by ensuring clear guidance and support.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项过程评估，主要关注实施障碍，而非干预措施本身的疗效。研究结果基于混合方法，可能存在定性数据的主观性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a process evaluation focusing on implementation barriers rather than the efficacy of the intervention itself. The findings are based on mixed methods, which may involve subjectivity in qualitative data.

items.title:
Clinical and functional outcomes of aquatic plyometrics in adolescent patellofemoral pain syndrome: a dual-arm randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A dual-arm RCT found aquatic plyometric exercises significantly improved pain, quadriceps and hamstring torque, functional disability, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome compared to conventional exercises.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT证实，与传统锻炼相比，水中增强式训练能显著改善青少年髌骨股骨疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌力量、功能障碍及生活质量。应考虑将其纳入临床实践。
items.titleZh: 青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者水生增强式训练的临床和功能结局：一项双臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂随机对照试验显示，与常规练习相比，水生增强式练习能显著改善青少年髌股疼痛综合征患者的疼痛、股四头肌和腘绳肌扭矩、功能障碍和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence that aquatic plyometrics are superior to conventional exercises for improving pain, strength, function, and quality of life in adolescents with patellofemoral pain syndrome. Clinicians should consider incorporating this intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究在沙特阿拉伯进行；其结果推广至其他人群需谨慎考虑。
items.limitationEn: Study conducted in Saudi Arabia; generalizability to other populations needs consideration.

items.title: Low balance confidence in relation to strength training, walking, sitting, and physical function among women aged 75–105 years: a cross-sectional study within the Women’s Health Initiative Strong and Healthy (WHISH) Intervention Cohort
items.summary: In women aged 75-105, low balance confidence was associated with increased sitting time and lower physical function, while higher balance confidence was linked to more strength training and walking. The prevalence of low balance confidence was higher in those aged 85+.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对75-105岁老年女性的横断面研究发现，平衡信心不足与久坐时间增加、身体功能下降相关，而平衡信心高则与力量训练、步行活动及更好的身体功能相关。这强化了在老年人群中推广这些活动的重要性。
items.titleZh: 75-105岁女性的平衡信心低与力量训练、行走、久坐和身体功能的关系：一项女性健康倡议强健与健康（WHISH）干预队列的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 在75-105岁的女性中，平衡信心低与久坐时间增加和身体功能下降有关，而平衡信心高则与更多的力量训练和行走有关。85岁以上女性的低平衡信心患病率更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study in older women (75-105 years) identifies strong associations between lower balance confidence and factors like sitting time, while higher confidence is linked to strength training, walking, and better physical function. This reinforces the importance of promoting these activities in geriatric populations.
items.limitation: 横断面设计限制了时间顺序的确定；研究结果需在纵向研究中得到证实。
items.limitationEn: Cross-sectional design limits the establishment of temporality; findings need confirmation in longitudinal studies.

items.title: Delivering a high-dose walking booster program after stroke: a multimethod study of therapists' beliefs and experiences nested within a randomized trial.
items.summary: This multimethod study explored intervention therapists' beliefs and experiences delivering a high-dose walking booster program (HiWalk) within a Phase II trial (n=6 therapists) for stroke survivors (>6 months post-stroke). Therapists largely believed high-dose training was important (98.5/100) but were less confident about patients completing 3 hours/day (74.8/100). Training, team support, and resources facilitated delivery, while beliefs about stroke survivor capability and resource limitations were barriers.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量步行训练的依从性在卒中康复中至关重要。本研究揭示，治疗师需要更强的信心和更多资源来确保患者达到高训练量，这是未来临床方案设计和实施的考量点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后高剂量步行强化训练的实施：一项多方法研究，探讨治疗师在随机试验中的信念和经验
items.summaryZh: 这项多方法研究探索了在二期临床试验背景下（n=6 名治疗师），干预治疗师在为卒中幸存者（卒中后超过 6 个月）提供高剂量步行强化训练（HiWalk）时的信念和经验。治疗师普遍认为高剂量训练很重要（98.5/100），但对患者每天完成 3 小时训练的信心较低（74.8/100）。培训、团队支持和资源是促进因素，而对患者能力的信念和资源限制是障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to high-dose walking training is crucial in stroke rehabilitation. This study reveals therapists need stronger confidence and more resources to ensure patients achieve high training volumes, which are key considerations for future clinical program design and implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究是在一个小型二期临床试验（n=6 名治疗师）背景下进行的，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within the context of a small Phase II clinical trial (n=6 therapists), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence and its association with 3-month hip functional recovery among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery: a prospective observational study.
items.summary: This prospective observational study (n=230 older adults) found that early postoperative functional exercise adherence before discharge was moderate (mean score 49.9 ± 6.9) among older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery. Higher adherence was associated with better 3-month hip functional recovery (Harris Hip Score, B = 0.842, p < 0.001). Kinesiophobia, rehabilitation self-efficacy, social support, and pain intensity were key associated factors.
